title: AI-Assisted Developer Workflows (Trace) AI Task Auditor - Freelance AI Trainer Project
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a AI-Assisted Developer Workflows (Trace) AI Task Auditor - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Saudi Arabia.

This freelance opportunity is designed for experienced technical specialists who want to help improve the quality and reliability of AI systems used in modern software development.

You will audit AI-assisted developer workflow tasks to ensure they are technically sound, realistic, reproducible, and properly evaluated.

The role involves testing complex technical scenarios, identifying workflow or logic issues, and assessing the effectiveness of supporting tests and evaluation criteria.

You’ll provide precise, actionable feedback on developer tooling, IDE integrations, AI-assisted coding workflows, and trace or telemetry analysis.

The project offers the flexibility of fully remote contract work and allows you to contribute directly to the development of more capable and dependable AI systems.

Your expertise will help ensure that AI training tasks reflect practical developer environments and meet rigorous technical standards.

Accountabilities

  • Evaluate developer workflow tasks for technical accuracy, realism, solvability, reproducibility, and alignment with reliable testing and evaluation criteria.
  • Audit AI-assisted development scenarios to identify technical inconsistencies, logic errors, workflow inefficiencies, or issues affecting task quality.
  • Assess IDE integrations, developer tooling, telemetry and trace analysis, and AI-assisted coding workflows within assigned areas of specialization.
  • Test and troubleshoot complex technical scenarios to determine whether tasks function as intended and can be consistently reproduced.
  • Provide clear, detailed, and actionable feedback that enables improvements to AI training and evaluation tasks.
  • Apply professional technical judgment to ensure audited workflows are practical and representative of real-world developer environments.

Requirements

  • Demonstrable professional experience and strong technical expertise in modern developer tooling and AI-assisted development workflows.
  • Familiarity with AI coding assistants, telemetry or trace analysis, IDE integrations, and broader developer workflow ecosystems.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to rigorously test, troubleshoot, and assess complex technical scenarios.
  • Ability to identify subtle technical issues and communicate findings clearly through concise, actionable feedback.
  • Candidates will be assessed for a specific area of specialization based on their professional experience; expertise across every listed domain is not required.
  • Strong attention to technical accuracy, reproducibility, and practical applicability.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment and manage assigned technical evaluation tasks effectively.
  • Access to a secure computer and reliable, high-speed internet connection is required.

Benefits

  • Competitive freelance compensation: $70–$100 USD per hour, with the final rate determined by experience, expertise, and geographic location.
  • Fully remote: Work remotely from India and contribute to a globally distributed AI training project.
  • Flexible contract format: Freelance engagement designed to provide flexibility in how and where you work.
  • Technical impact: Apply your professional expertise to help improve the rigor, reliability, and practical quality of AI systems.
  • Specialized work: Focus on the developer workflow specialty most closely aligned with your background.
  • Contractor status: Health insurance, paid time off, and other company-sponsored employee benefits are not included.
  • Equipment: Contractors are responsible for providing a secure computer and high-speed internet connection.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

companyDescription:
Jobgether is a career navigation platform built for senior professionals competing in the remote job market. Hiring systems were designed for volume and keyword matching, not for 15 or 20 years of nonlinear experience. That structural mismatch is why strong profiles get filtered out before a human ever sees them.

Our platform diagnoses where a search is breaking, corrects how experience is positioned, and connects professionals to the companies where their background creates real value. The goal is not more applications. It is the right visibility in the right places.

Our mission is to ensure no senior professional remains invisible in the global remote market, not because they lack the skills, but because the system failed to read them correctly.

title: Data Analyst II (Saudi National)
descriptionHtml:
Hungerstation is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

As a Data Analyst II at HungerStation, you will support the product development lifecycle by analyzing data, understanding user needs, and providing actionable insights that help optimize product performance.

You will work closely with Product, Technology, Marketing, Commercial, Logistics/Operations, and Growth teams to turn data into meaningful insights and support data-driven decision-making.

In This Role, You Will

  • Analyze product and business data to understand growth drivers and identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Develop analyses, reports, and interactive dashboards to support business teams and stakeholders.
  • Use quantitative analysis to uncover insights and help Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers understand what to build and why.
  • Work with structured and semi-structured data from multiple sources, including BigQuery, Redshift, and PostgreSQL.
  • Use SQL (BigQuery) and Python or R to extract, process, and analyze large datasets.
  • Design and analyze A/B tests by defining hypotheses, setting up experiments, and evaluating results using statistical methods.
  • Own data projects from data collection through to operationalization.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports using tools such as Looker Cloud, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or similar visualization platforms.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of data and analytical processes.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of relevant experience in Data Analytics or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a relevant field.
  • Strong SQL skills, with experience using BigQuery.
  • Python or R experience is required.
  • Basic knowledge of statistics and experience applying statistical methods to data.
  • Experience working with large datasets and data from multiple sources.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience creating dashboards and reports using tools such as Looker Cloud, Tableau, Google Data Studio, or similar.
  • Ability to translate data into clear, actionable insights for business and product stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work across Product, Technology, Marketing, Commercial, Logistics/Operations, and Growth teams.

title: AI Project Manager / Scrum Master - Senior Associate
descriptionHtml:
About Us

With offices in 152 countries and nearly 328,000 professionals, we are one of the world’s leading professional services networks, helping organisations and individuals create lasting value through Assurance, Tax and Advisory services. For over 40 years, we have contributed to the Middle East’s transformation journey, partnering with governments and businesses to deliver sustainable solutions. Today, more than 12,000 of us across Bahrain, Egypt, Iraq, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Oman, Palestine, Qatar, Saudi Arabia and the UAE are shaping the region’s future.

Line Of Service Overview

Internal Firm Services (IFS) brings together the specialist functions that enable PwC Middle East to run, grow and transform—supporting our people, clients and business with the capabilities needed for the future of work. A career in IFS offers diverse opportunities across Human Capital, Finance, Technology & AI, Clients & Markets, Marketing & Communications, Risk & Quality, Partner Development, Office Management, and Transformation & Change. As we continue to embed data, technology and new-age AI into how we work, we are hiring talent who can help our teams become more AI-enabled, digitally confident and ready to create greater value across PwC Middle East.

Business Unit Overview

T he AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE) is our central engine for AI strategy, product build, and scale. It governs standards and cost and risk controls, runs AI Factory squads to design and ship custom AI solutions and reusable frameworks (LLM and RAG stacks, integrations on Azure), provides technical consultation on architecture, solution design, and best practices, and drives workforce transformation through training and upskilling to accelerate adoption across our lines of service.

Operating within IFS, the CoE partners with Experience Design and adjacent technology teams, follows a codified operating model and RACI for approvals and observability, and supports proposals, demos, and delivery with a focus on distinctive outcomes and trusted leadership.

How You’ll Contribute

As a Project Manager/Scrum Master, you’ll be responsible for coordinating and delivering AI and GenAI initiatives using Agile methodologies. The role combines project management, sprint facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and delivery governance to ensure successful execution of AI products and solutions.

Working closely with Product Managers, Architects, Engineers, and business stakeholders, the role ensures delivery commitments are met, risks are proactively managed, and teams operate efficiently within the AI CoE delivery framework.

Agile Delivery & Scrum Facilitation

  • Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
  • Support backlog refinement activities and sprint readiness.
  • Track sprint progress and team commitments.
  • Identify and remove delivery impediments and blockers.
  • Promote Agile best practices and continuous improvement within the team.
  • Help teams improve sprint predictability, quality, and delivery performance.

Project Coordination

  • Develop and maintain project schedules, milestones, and delivery plans.
  • Coordinate activities across business and technical teams.
  • Track project progress against agreed timelines and deliverables.
  • Monitor dependencies, risks, assumptions, and issues.
  • Escalate delivery concerns appropriately and ensure timely resolution.
  • Leveraging historical project data to spot bottlenecks, predict delays, and prevent budget overruns before they occur.
  • Support project governance and status reporting.

Stakeholder Management

  • Act as a central point of coordination between stakeholders and delivery teams.
  • Communicate project status, risks, and key decisions to stakeholders.
  • Ensure alignment between business expectations and delivery commitments.

AI Delivery Support

  • Support delivery of AI, GenAI, automation, analytics, and digital transformation initiatives.
  • Coordinate activities between Product Managers, Architects, Developers, QA, and Business Analysts.
  • Ensure project activities align with AI CoE delivery standards and governance requirements.

Reporting & Governance

  • Prepare weekly project status reports and dashboards.
  • Maintain project documentation and action logs.
  • Track RAID (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) registers.

What You’ll Bring

 Experience

  • 3-8 years of experience in Project Management, Scrum Master, PMO, or Agile Delivery roles.
  • Experience delivering technology, AI, data, analytics, or software development projects.
  • Experience working in Agile environments.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams.

Education & Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Administration or a related field.
  • PMI-PMP Certified

Technical Skills & Specialized Knowledge

 Project Management

  • Project planning and coordination
  • Risk and issue management
  • Stakeholder communication
  • Status reporting
  • Dependency management
  • Documentation and governance

Agile & Scrum

  • Scrum framework
  • Kanban principles
  • Sprint planning and execution
  • Agile ceremonies facilitation
  • Team coaching
  • Continuous improvement

Technical Awareness

  • Understanding of AI and Generative AI concepts
  • Software development lifecycle (SDLC)
  • Cloud and data platform fundamentals
  • AI product delivery lifecycle

Tools

  • Jira
  • Azure DevOps
  • Asana
  • Microsoft 365 Suite

Attributes & Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate across multi-located and diverse teams.
  • Ability to understand and translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Curious, proactive, and eager to learn.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication in English; Arabic is preferred.

What Sets You Apart

  • Passion for AI, Generative AI, and emerging technologies.
  • Strong facilitator who can bridge business and technical teams.
  • Proactive problem-solver who removes blockers and drives delivery.
  • Excellent communicator with strong stakeholder management skills.
  • Highly organized and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Collaborative, agile-minded, and focused on continuous improvement.
  • Motivated by turning innovative ideas into impactful business solutions.

How You’ll Make a Difference

At PwC Midde East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.

Why You’ll Love Working at PwC

At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job - you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

title: Intern, Artificial Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
Role Summary
APCO is looking for an AI Intern to join our Dubai office and support the development, testing, and application of AI-enabled tools across communications, research, and digital transformation work. This internship is designed for a curious and analytical individual who is interested in how artificial intelligence, natural language processing, and emerging technologies can help organizations better understand issues, audiences, and opportunities. The intern will work closely with the AI and Digital Transformation team to support practical AI use cases, data analysis, research, and experimentation in a fast-paced advisory environment.
Responsibilities
- Support the development, testing, and refinement of AI and natural language processing tools for research, analysis, and communications-related use cases.
- Assist with collecting, cleaning, organizing, and analyzing structured and unstructured data from multiple sources.
- Help identify patterns, insights, and opportunities that can support client work and internal innovation.
- Conduct research on emerging AI tools, digital transformation trends, and relevant applications across communications, public affairs, and advisory work.
- Support the preparation of presentations, summaries, reports, and visual outputs that communicate technical insights in a clear and practical way.
- Collaborate with team members to test AI models, evaluate outputs, and document findings, recommendations, and potential improvements.
- Contribute to internal knowledge sharing by tracking new technologies, tools, and use cases relevant to APCO’s work.
Requirements
- Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in computer science, computer engineering, data science, artificial intelligence, or a related field.
- Strong interest in artificial intelligence, machine learning, natural language processing, and digital transformation.
- Working knowledge of Python and familiarity with common data analysis or machine learning libraries is preferred.
- Ability to work with data, conduct research, and communicate insights clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Curious, proactive, and comfortable experimenting with new tools and technologies.
- Strong attention to detail, problem-solving skills, and willingness to learn in a collaborative environment.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic is a plus.
- Available to join as an intern in APCO’s Dubai office.
Careers at APCO
Through our recruitment, hiring and retention efforts, APCO is committed to building teams to bring the best possible expertise and robust perspectives to our clients. We embrace differences in experience, viewpoint and ideas, starting with our values and extending to our behaviors, policies and practices. We aim to create a positive work experience and welcoming environment where everyone feels they belong and can thrive.

title: Forward Deployed Data Scientist Expert
descriptionHtml:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What You'll Build

In this role, you design, develop, and apply advanced data science, statistical, and machine learning methods to solve complex, business-critical problems. Embedded directly within customer environments and fast-moving delivery teams, you translate strategic and operational challenges into rigorous analytical solutions at speed. You work closely with customers to deliver scalable, enterprise-grade outcomes that drive measurable business value. You are accountable for the quality, impact, and delivery of complex analytical initiatives — acting as a subject-matter expert, managing ambiguity, and ensuring data-driven solutions are robust, reliable, and aligned with business objectives.

In This Role, You Will

  • Transform complex business challenges into data-driven intelligence by identifying high-value problems, framing them analytically, and engineering robust features and insights.
  • Design, develop, train, and implement mathematical models, algorithms, and machine learning solutions to solve complex business problems.
  • Apply advanced techniques across exploratory analysis, statistical modeling, experimentation, forecasting, segmentation, anomaly detection, causal analysis, and machine learning.
  • Integrate analytical and machine learning solutions into products, prototypes, or business processes, ensuring enterprise-grade scalability and robustness.
  • Define success metrics, quantify business impact, and translate analytical results into clear, actionable recommendations for decision-makers.
  • Lead or manage complex analytical workstreams or projects, including deliverables, milestones, risks, and escalations, as appropriate.
  • Communicate insights, trade-offs, and recommendations effectively to cross-functional teams and customer stakeholders, influencing decisions through evidence and expertise.
  • Work in an embedded, customer-facing setup, collaborating closely with customer teams to deeply understand their data, applications, and business context — co-developing impactful data and AI-driven solutions.

What You Bring

  • Expert-level proficiency in data science and machine learning, with strong command of Python and SQL, and the ability to design, validate, and optimize end-to-end analytical and ML solutions.
  • Hands-on expertise with Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, and XGBoost.
  • Deep applied knowledge of statistics and experimentation, including hypothesis testing, experimental design, causal inference, and uncertainty interpretation.
  • Proven experience applying a wide range of ML techniques — classification, forecasting, clustering, recommendation systems, anomaly detection — balancing accuracy, robustness, interpretability, and usability at scale.
  • Strong capability to translate ambiguous business questions into measurable analytical problems and connect model outputs to commercial, operational, or strategic decisions.
  • Experience delivering production-ready analytics and ML systems on modern data platforms, with a strong focus on data quality, governance, and reusability.
  • Exposure to SAP data landscapes including SAP S/4HANA, SAP BW/4HANA, SAP HANA Cloud, and familiarity with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), AI Core, AI Launchpad, and SAP AI services.
  • Ability to operate effectively in an Agentic AI context, contributing to the design, application, and responsible use of AI agents within complex business processes.
  • Advanced communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders through clear data narratives and executive-ready insights.
  • You proactively leverage AI in everyday workflows, ensuring high-quality outputs through thoughtful context design and system integration.

Where You Belong

You will be part of a growing AI and industry expert team dedicated to serving customers across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. We bring together deep AI expertise, strong industry knowledge, and regional understanding to help customers innovate and lead in their markets. We work closely with decision-makers, challenge assumptions with data, and give data scientists room to influence strategy — not just produce analysis. This is a place for people who enjoy building something meaningful. You will thrive here if you are intellectually curious, customer-centric, and energized by the opportunity to drive real-world outcomes in a fast-evolving AI landscape.

#SAPIndustryAICareers

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

AI Usage in the Recruitment Process

For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.

Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

title: AI Tech Consultant Enterprise Solutions - Riyadh | BCG Platinion
descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

At BCG Platinion, we close the gap between strategy and technology. We design and build AI tech strategies, AI solutions, and next-generation platform architectures that turn ambition into execution, turning buzzwords into a true business engine and real competitive advantage.

Working at the intersection of boardroom strategy and hands-on tech delivery, we help leading organizations tackle their toughest challenges, with access to C-suite leaders and the unmatched resources of BCG.

Join BCG Platinion's Enterprise Solutions team in our Middle East offices (Dubai, Riyadh) as an enterprise solutions expert, shaping and delivering AI-enabled transformation programs for major clients across the region.

What You'll Do

  • Support clients through end-to-end enterprise solutions transformation programs (covering ERP, CRM, HCM, SCM, Planning, Manufacturing), from strategy such as business case and roadmap definition, business process definition, technical reference architecture design and selection of solutions and implementation partners, through to implementation governance and quality assurance
  • Design and deliver AI-enabled and agentic ERP use cases, from AI-accelerated delivery such as test generation, data migration and documentation, through to autonomous agents in financial close, procurement and order to cash, always within defined governance and data guardrails
  • Introduce best practices from business requirements specification to solution implementation, minimizing one-off customizations and reducing maintenance costs
  • Contribute to the Enterprise Solutions chapter at BCG Platinion by sharing your expertise, for example attending the most relevant conferences and events, researching and experimenting with the latest technology including GenAI and agentic AI, and authoring innovative articles

What You'll Bring

  • Education: An above average degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration or a related field, with strong academic performance preferred
  • Experience: 3 to 4 years of relevant experience driving enterprise solutions transformation programs in CRM, ERP, HCM, SCM, Planning or Manufacturing, with SAP S/4HANA preferred. Strong candidates from 2 years will also be considered
  • Functional knowledge: Solid grasp of typical end-to-end business processes (for example Procure-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash, Lead-to-Quote, Record-to-Report, Hire-to-Retire) and how they are implemented
  • Technical knowledge: Familiarity with industry specific solutions (for example SAP IS-OIL), add-ons (for example APO/IBP, Treasury/BCM, FSCM, Transportation Management, BPC/SEM), analytical tools (for example SAP BW/BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, Digital Boardroom) and AI-enabled ERP capabilities (for example SAP Joule and Business AI, S/4HANA embedded AI, agentic workflows on SAP BTP, clean core and extension strategy)
  • AI fluency: Practical use of GenAI tools (for example ChatGPT, Claude) including the ability to validate and challenge output, with curiosity about applying agentic AI to ERP processes
  • Soft skills: Excellent teamwork, communication and presentation skills, eager to learn and improve, with intellectual agility and a proven ability to align diverse stakeholders behind a common goal, exceptional analytical and conceptual thinking, and a strong client focus and results driven approach
  • Language: Fluency in English, Arabic a strong plus
  • Travel: Willingness to travel regularly across the region to client sites

Who You'll Work With

At BCG Platinion, we tackle our clients' most critical IT challenges at the intersection of business and technology. We guide organizations through their ERP transformations, including the migration to SAP S/4HANA ahead of ECC's end of life. These are complex programs that raise hard questions about business justification, tangible benefits and the optimal roadmap, taking into account the implications for the overall architecture as well as alternative solutions and platforms.

The market has moved again. ERP is shifting from a passive system of record to an intelligent system that anticipates, recommends and acts. BCG describes this as four stages, from automated to predictive to generative to agentic ERP, where agentic systems act autonomously inside clear governance guardrails. AI is no longer a pilot running alongside the core program, it is becoming a standard accelerator within it. Our clients across the GCC are asking how to get there quickly and responsibly, without carrying forward the inefficiencies of the last decade.

To meet this growing demand, we are expanding our Enterprise Solutions team. As an AI Tech Consultant in Enterprise Solutions, you will work alongside BCG technology and strategy experts on local and global projects, bridging deep technical know-how with strategic insight. Partnering with clients, you will develop superior, business value driven ERP and application architecture strategies, concepts and roadmaps, applying your technical and functional process expertise to deliver high impact outcomes. Most importantly, you will embody the BCG Platinion spirit by taking a hands-on, collaborative approach to solving problems in innovative ways.

Additional info

We make sure you never stop growing. You'll tackle exciting, high-impact challenges every day, supported by a passionate team of talented colleagues who share your drive for excellence and keep connect long after your case wraps up. Our collaborative, open culture gives you the freedom to explore and perfect your strengths, backed by individual learning opportunities and recognized certifications.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Associate AI Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Who Are We❓

We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners.

The Job in a Nutshell💡

You'll build the internal AI systems our engineers work inside every day: agents that generate and maintain tests, pipelines that triage failures before a human sees them, tooling that speeds up code review and debugging, and the evaluation infrastructure that makes our own AI features testable at all.

This is a builder's role. You'll write production code, own systems in CI, and be measured on whether engineers actually use what you ship.

What Will You Do❓

Test automation across the stack

  • Backend: API and contract testing, service-level and integration coverage, data setup that doesn't rot, and test design that survives a schema change
  • Frontend: web E2E and component-level coverage with Playwright, visual and RTL regression, and suites fast enough to gate a merge rather than a nightly
  • Mobile: native and cross-platform coverage with Appium or Maestro, device-farm strategy, offline and sync behaviour, and the payment-peripheral paths that only break on real hardware
  • The connective tissue: shared fixtures, environment and test-data management, parallelisation, and CI pipelines where a red build means something
  • performance and load testing Experience

The AI layer on top of it

  • Test generation from specs, code, and production traffic — with the maintenance story solved, not just the first draft
  • Failure triage that classifies a red build before a human opens it: real bug, flake, environment, or test rot
  • Self-healing locators and suite health tooling — flake detection, quarantine, coverage-gap analysis
  • Evaluation infrastructure for AI features across our products: datasets, scoring, and regression detection when a prompt or model changes
  • Evaluation for our market specifically — Arabic and English behaviour, RTL interfaces, and region-specific POS, tax, and payment rules. Correctness here is rarely a string match

Agentic AI and orchestration

  • Agentic AI that does real work in our pipelines: reads a diff, runs the relevant suite, reproduces a failure, proposes a fix, opens the PR
  • Agents that own a quality workflow end to end — exploratory testing against a running build, coverage-gap hunting, release-risk assessment — and know when to escalate to a human
  • Orchestration that holds up under load — multi-step planning, tool use, retries, state and memory across steps, sandboxed execution, multi-agent handoffs, and clean boundaries between agentic and deterministic steps
  • Integration with the stack we already have (CI, Jira, observability, MCP-style tool interfaces) rather than a parallel system beside it
  • The judgement to know when a plain pipeline beats an agent, and to say so

The technical ground

You should be current on how this work is actually done today, and able to argue about it rather than recite it:

  • Test automation: framework design and layering, the test pyramid and where it stops being useful, flake economics, parallel execution, mobile and cross-browser realities, CI/CD gating, Framework: Playwright, Appium, Maestro
  • Agentic AI: orchestration and tool use, multi-step planning, memory and state, sandboxed execution, multi-agent patterns, MCP and similar tool-integration standards, and the cost of each
  • Context engineering: retrieval strategy, chunking, reranking, caching, and managing long-context behaviour — including where it degrades
  • Evaluation: offline and online evals, LLM-as-judge and its failure modes, human-in-the-loop review, statistical significance on small samples, regression gates in CI
  • Reliability: structured output, guardrails, fallback and retry design, and handling non-determinism in systems that must not flap
  • Operations: tracing and observability for LLM systems, prompt and version management, latency and cost budgeting, model routing, and when fine-tuning or distillation beats a better prompt

What Are We Looking For❓

  • An engineer who ships production software, with recent hands-on work on LLM-backed systems that real users depend on.
  • Strong Python; comfortable in at least one of .NET, Java, or TypeScript. Tested, maintained code — not notebooks
  • Real automation depth across more than one surface. You've owned a suite that gates releases on backend and on a UI — web or mobile — and you can explain how you kept it green without deleting the hard tests
  • Real experience building evaluation systems. You can explain how you knew your system was getting better, with numbers
  • Practical depth with the modern LLM toolkit — prompting, structured output, tool use, retrieval, agentic AI orchestration — and a clear sense of the trade-offs
  • Credible testing fundamentals. You don't need a QA title, but test design, automation frameworks, and CI/CD shouldn't be new to you
  • A bias toward adoption. You measure your work by what other engineers use, not by what you demoed

What We Offer You❗

We believe you will love working at Foodics!

  • We have an inclusive and diverse culture that encourages innovation and flexibility in-office, and hybrid work setups
  • We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares
  • We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment
  • Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry
  • We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company

title: Specialist - Motor Pricing
descriptionHtml:
Overview:


We're looking for a curious, analytically minded pricing specialist to join our pricing team. You'll help build, refine, and monitor the pricing models that sit behind our products, turning large volumes of data into insight that shapes real commercial decisions.


This is a hands-on technical role suited to someone who genuinely enjoys getting into the detail of data and models—understanding why the numbers move, not just what they are. You'll be supported to develop deep expertise in pricing and to grow your skills across the pricing toolkit we use over time.


Key responsibilities


- Build, refine, and maintain technical and retail pricing models, using generalized linear models (GLMs).

- Use the WTW pricing suite: Emblem & Radar.

- Extract, clean, and manipulate large datasets using SAS, SQL, and Excel to support pricing analysis.

- Monitor portfolio performance—loss ratios, conversion, retention, mix, and volumes—and flag emerging trends to the wider team.

- Support periodic rate reviews and ad hoc pricing investigations, presenting clear findings to pricing managers and stakeholders.

- Help implement and test rate changes, ensuring accuracy through robust checking, reconciliation, and documentation.


Essential skills and experience


- A degree in a numerate discipline, for example, actuarial science, mathematics, statistics, data science, or economics.

- Strong analytical and numerical ability, with sound understanding of statistical concepts.

- Proficiency in SAS, SQL and Excel, or clear evidence of the aptitude to pick them up quickly.

- High attention to detail and a methodical, accuracy-focused approach to data.

- The ability to explain technical results clearly to non-technical audiences.


Desirable skills and experience


- Experience with the WTW pricing suite (Emblem, Radar) or comparable pricing software.

- Prior experience in general insurance pricing.

- Familiarity with the Saudi market and pricing regulations.

- Exposure to machine learning methods used in pricing, such as gradient boosting.

Tawuniya has the resources and means to extend its products to meet retail and corporate needs while simultaneously transacting in various classes of risks, whether simple or complicated. title: مهندس وكلاء ذكاء اصطناعي (AI Agent Engineer)
descriptionHtml:
نبحث عن شخص متمكن عمليًا من بناء AI Agents باستخدام نماذج الذكاء الاصطناعي المختلفة، ولديه القدرة على تحويل احتياجات المدير إلى وكيل ذكي آمن وموثوق وقابل للاستخدام الفعلي داخل بيئة العمل.

المهام:

• تصميم وبناء وكلاء ذكاء اصطناعي مخصصين وفق احتياج كل مدير.

• ربط الوكلاء بالبريد الإلكتروني والتقويم والملفات وأنظمة الشركات والأدوات المختلفة.

• بناء تدفقات عمل متعددة الخطوات وتنفيذ المهام بصورة آلية.

• تطوير الذاكرة والسياق والصلاحيات وآليات الموافقة البشرية.

• تحسين دقة الوكيل وتقليل الأخطاء والهلوسة.

• اختبار الوكلاء ومراقبة أدائهم وتطويرهم باستمرار.

• المساهمة في بناء منصة قابلة للتوسع وخدمة عدد كبير من الشركات والمديرين.


المتطلبات:

• خبرة عملية مثبتة في بناء AI Agents

• خبرة في نماذج مثل OpenAI وClaude وGemini وغيرها.

title: COOP Trainee (For current students - second semester COOP, starting in January 2027)
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

In alignment with the Vision 2030 of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Visa is delighted to offer opportunities for Cooperative Training to Saudi students! This program is designed to successfully blend academic learning with practical work experience, providing the perfect platform for students to apply theoretical knowledge in a real-world setting. It is a crucial component of our recruitment strategy and our dedication to unlocking talent in Saudi Arabia!

Joining an international industry leader such as Visa is an experience that will enrich you personally and professionally. We have designed a detailed learning journey that will aid your development and set you up for success in your career.

Opportunities available in the following 4 departments: Consulting, Business Development, Finance & Marketing.

Visa Consulting & Analytics (VCA)

VCA is the payments consulting arm of Visa, focused on serving Visa’s clients and partners. We offer consulting and analytics services across different areas of interest to our clients including strategy, product, portfolio management, risk, digital and more.

Within VCA, we have a dedicated Data Science team who are passionate about statistics, advanced analytics and machine learning with best-in-class access to insights from VisaNet, one of the largest payment networks in the world.

Business Development (BD)

The business development team drives the country strategy and its objectives by identifying, leading, and driving, through analytics, data and market intelligence, on opportunities to drive business growth for Visa and its clients. As a BD COOP Trainee, you will provide support to the team, assisting with client requests with the purpose to grow Visa share of business.

Marketing

The team focuses on driving awareness, preference and conversion across B2B and B2C. They build the brand, with a client centric approach, by reinforcing emotional affinity via innovation and tangible proof points. This is an opportunity to use your creativity, express ideas, and make a real contribution to the organization and its mission.

Finance

As a Finance intern, you will gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced global payments environment while contributing to meaningful business projects from day one. You may support teams across deals, pricing, financial planning, controllership, help analyze financial data, identify trends, and provide insights that support business decisions. Your work could include assisting analysis of balance sheet and cash flow drivers, building stress-testing scenarios, reviewing financial results and variances, and helping ensure the accuracy and consistency of financial data.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

  • Must be available for a full-time COOP starting in January 2027 (2nd semester COOP only)
  • Current student working towards a Bachelors degree, with a graduation date of 2027. Must be available for a full-time graduate role in September 2027
  • Must be well-versed and curious on the latest AI tools
  • Economics / Financial Economics, Marketing, Business, Finance, IT/MIS, and Engineering disciplines welcome to apply
  • Excellent academic record
  • Saudi National
  • Strong in MS Excel, Word & PowerPoint

Visa is an EEO Employer

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Growth Hacking Specialist (Digital Growth Specialist), (full-time, on-site, Riyadh)
descriptionHtml:
Growth Hacking Specialist (Digital Growth Specialist)


Employment Type: Full-time

Location: On-site at our offices in Riyadh


About Setup.sa

Setup.sa is a Saudi Consulting firm specializing in softlanding and market entry solutions for international companies. We pride ourselves in being a knowledge house, driven by technology.

Setup.sa was able to leave a mark and build its name in the competitive Saudi market in an exceptionally short time.

As we scale, we still strive to offer operational excellence while changing the way softlanding is done in KSA and raising the bar for the standards of service provision in our sector, pushing the expectations of the clients and the market higher.

Being a consulting house, we exist to ensure that the process and journey for foreign companies’ incorporation and operations is done in the easiest and most cost-efficient way possible.

We keep our promises to exceed our clients’ expectations by always going the extra mile, even if the client doesn’t get to know about it.

The people working with us expect a lot from themselves and are interested in building solutions that change the way the industry works. They have strong ambitions to achieve exceptional success personally and professionally.

Our team is performance-driven and serious. And we would like to invite you to work with us and become a part of a growing company that has a credible brand name and enjoy an exceptional learning journey.


About the Role

We are looking for a technically driven professional who is passionate about growth and combines programming, data, and digital marketing to build measurable, automated growth systems that attract high-quality leads and convert them into sales. This is not a traditional marketing role. It is a high-intensity execution role based on rapid experimentation, data, technical tools, and artificial intelligence to build scalable acquisition, activation, and conversion channels. You will work on launching an extraordinary product in the local market and gain rare hands-on experience in building growth engines from scratch.


Responsibilities

● Plan and execute advertising campaigns on social media platforms to attract high-quality potential customers, continuously measure cost versus results, and optimize performance.

● Improve the website’s search engine visibility (SEO) from both a technical and content perspective, and monitor keywords, pages, speed, and site structure.

● Manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns in a practical, results-driven way, including conversion tracking and return analysis.

● Build and run large-scale automated email campaigns (sequences, audience segmentation, A/B testing, and improving open, click, and conversion rates).

● Produce and intensively publish high-quality content across the relevant channels, linking content to growth objectives rather than content for its own sake.

● Edit images and videos for campaigns, social media, landing pages, and other growth content using relevant editing tools.

● Use market and competitor research tools, as well as social listening and social media analysis tools, to identify growth opportunities and the most effective messaging.

● Build and automate CRM systems and follow-up pipelines (Lead capture → qualification → nurture → conversion), integrating different sources into one system.

● Manage the website in terms of performance, conversion, integrations, tracking, and landing page optimization.

● Leverage artificial intelligence (especially Claude and its tools) for research, content writing and improvement, data analysis, prototyping, and automating repetitive tasks.

● Write internal scripts and tools in Python to collect, clean, and analyze data, automate reports, and connect systems.

● Design rapid growth experiments, measure results, stop what does not work, and scale what does.

● Set up clear dashboards for core growth metrics: traffic, leads, lead quality, cost, conversion, and revenue.


Requirements

● Fresh graduate from a College of Information Technology or an equivalent technical major, with no more than 2 years of practical experience.

● Strong knowledge of Python, with excellent practical programming skills (automation, working with APIs, data processing, and building simple internal tools).

● Knowledge of image and video editing tools, with the ability to produce clean, usable visual content for campaigns and digital channels.

● Ability and willingness to learn photography to support content production when needed.

● Basic understanding of SEO techniques (On-page, Technical SEO, keyword fundamentals, and performance tracking).

● Basic understanding of Google Ads, campaign mechanics, tracking, and optimization.

● Deep understanding of Claude.ai and its tools, with practical ability to use it to accelerate research, writing, analysis, and automation.

● Excellent English, both spoken and written.

● Ability to work on-site at our offices in Riyadh.

● Strong ability to self-learn, experiment quickly, and operate with ambiguity in a startup environment.

● Willingness to put in exceptional effort and work long hours when needed.

● A data-driven mindset: decisions are based on numbers, not impressions.

● Discipline in daily execution and follow-up, with attention to detail and output quality. Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

● Previous practical experience managing social media campaigns or building landing pages.

● Familiarity with tools such as: Google Analytics / GA4, Search Console, Looker Studio, Meta Ads, SEO tools, and automation tools (Zapier / Make or similar).

● Experience with tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Canva, or similar image and video editing software.

● Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS or working with content management systems.

● Experience building tracking setups (UTM, pixels, events) and understanding the conversion journey.

● Clear passion for entrepreneurship and product building. What You Will Get

● A real opportunity to build a growth engine from scratch, not just execute routine tasks.

● Focused and rare experience at the intersection of technology, data, artificial intelligence, and sales.

● Direct involvement in launching an extraordinary product in the local market, with a clear impact on results.

● A fast learning environment and broad responsibility from day one.


Important Note

This role is suitable for someone who wants to work at a high pace and accepts pressure in exchange for rapid learning and significant impact. If you are looking for a traditional job with fixed hours and narrowly defined tasks only, this role is not a fit.

title: Consultant — Research and Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Transform the way leaders change the world through rigorous, data-driven analytics.

As a consultant in Gallup’s Global Analytics division, you will collaborate closely with consultants, researchers and clients to help global leaders understand complex social and policy issues and act with confidence based on what the data reveal. In this role, you will develop hypotheses to test, dive deeply into complex datasets and produce precise, defensible analytics that directly address critical research questions.

Gallup produces some of the most widely cited global research in the world, covering topics such as world happiness, financial inclusion and modern slavery. Our Global Analytics work supports governments, institutions and organizations that rely on high-quality data to inform decisions that shape lives and communities around the world.

If you demonstrate rigor, intellectual curiosity and the highest standards of data integrity in your work, apply today.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner with consultants and clients to understand research objectives, ask thoughtful questions and translate analytic goals into rigorous analytic approaches
  • Conduct in-depth quantitative analysis, including data validation, cross-tabulation, modeling and exploratory analysis, with exceptional attention to accuracy and detail
  • Dive deeply into datasets to test hypotheses, explore ways to incorporate secondary data and uncover meaningful patterns that address client research questions
  • Prepare clear documentation on analytic workflows and other data sources used that can be audited
  • Prepare clear analytic outputs that enable consultants and partners to craft compelling narratives and client-ready deliverables
  • Support client engagements and prospect meetings by joining calls, listening carefully to clients’ goals and providing analytical perspective
  • Uphold Gallup’s highest standards for data integrity, ensuring every output is precise, defensible and reliable
  • Continuously strengthen your analytic toolkit by applying new methods, technologies and approaches to complex research challenges

Who We Want

  • Expert analysts who are passionate about research, explore smart hypotheses, identify patterns and trends, discover insights, and share discoveries with partners and clients
  • Meticulous perfectionists who hold themselves to the highest standards of excellence for data accuracy, efficiency and client satisfaction
  • Disciplined achievers who thrive in a deadline-driven, high-pressure environment
  • Resourceful problem-solvers who take accountability for discrepancies, work diligently to resolve concerns and develop systems to prevent future issues
  • Sophisticated communicators with excellent interpersonal skills to answer technical questions and translate complex information into understandable and meaningful takeaways for clients and partners

What You Need

  • Master’s degree required
  • Saudi National required
  • At least two years of professional experience in quantitative research methods, statistics, math, economics or a similar quantitative discipline required
  • At least two years of experience working with complex survey data, including validating data quality, conducting statistical analysis and supporting insight development required
  • Proficiency in Python, R or SQL required
  • Full fluency in Arabic and English required
  • Client-facing experience preferred

What You’ll Experience

  • Mission-driven work: Make a meaningful difference for organizations, governments and individuals with your unique contributions, commitment to service and exceptional outcomes.
  • Engaged teams: Join world-class managers, highly productive colleagues and knowledgeable mentors who are enthusiastic about their work.
  • Learning opportunities: Focus on continuous growth by developing your strengths, feeding your curiosity, challenging conventional thinking and experimenting.
  • Brand strength, startup energy: Thrive in an innovative culture backed by a trusted brand.
  • A collaborative environment: Work where your ideas, perspectives and experiences are welcomed and valued.

About Gallup

At Gallup, we change the world, one client at a time, through extraordinary analytics and advice on everything important facing humankind. Learn more about our work and life at Gallup.

Gallup offers a robust benefits package that includes competitive pay; medical, life and critical illness insurance; a retirement savings program; an employee stock ownership program; mass transit reimbursement; family-building benefits; an employee assistance program; and various reimbursements and activities that enhance our associates’ wellbeing.

Gallup is an equal opportunity employer. Employment decisions are based on qualifications and business needs. We value diversity and are committed to an inclusive workplace.

To review Gallup’s Privacy Statement, please click this link: https://www.gallup.com/privacy. This privacy policy is meant to help you understand what information we collect, why we collect it, and how you can update, manage and delete your information. Your application and the information you provide will be processed and stored in the United States.

Agencies: We are not partnering with agencies for this role, nor will we accept unsolicited résumés or be responsible for any fees or expenses related to such unsolicited résumés and/or applicants.

title: Ubuntu/Linux User for AI Data Training
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for people who regularly use Ubuntu/Linux. No prior AI experience is required. If you are comfortable working in Ubuntu, installing applications, following instructions, and completing technical tasks independently, we would like to hear from you.

As an AI Data Trainer with Linux/Ubuntu, you will work remotely on an hourly paid basis to support AI data training projects through structured, detail-oriented tasks. You will install applications and record your actions while completing tasks with patience, concentration, and strong attention to detail.

This role requires you to have your own computer running Ubuntu/Linux and to be comfortable installing the applications and tools needed for the project. While advanced AI experience is not required, you should be tech-savvy, reliable, careful with instructions, and able to work independently.

This role is a good fit for students, junior candidates, Linux enthusiasts, and other tech-savvy individuals who are patient, focused, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with Ubuntu/Linux.

This is a fully remote, hourly paid contractor role with SME Careers, a fast-growing AI data services company and subsidiary of SuperAnnotate that provides AI training data to many of the world’s largest AI companies and foundation model labs. Your work will directly contribute to improving AI systems used across products and industries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Follow detailed written guidelines and apply them carefully
  • Install and use required applications on an Ubuntu/Linux computer
  • Check work for mistakes before submission
  • Identify inconsistencies, unclear instructions, or technical issues when they arise
  • Maintain focus during repetitive or detail-heavy tasks
  • Complete assigned work within agreed weekly availability
  • Communicate clearly with the project team when support is needed
  • Contribute to improving the quality of AI model training data

Your Profile

  • Have access to a personal computer running Ubuntu/Linux
  • Be comfortable installing required apps, tools, and project software
  • Be tech-savvy and able to follow setup instructions independently
  • Be available for approximately 15 hours per week
  • Be patient, concentrated, and detail-oriented
  • Be able to follow written instructions carefully and consistently
  • Be comfortable completing structured and sometimes repetitive tasks
  • Have basic computer literacy and confidence using browser-based tools
  • Be reliable, responsive, and able to meet task deadlines
  • Student candidates and junior applicants are welcome
  • Previous experience in AI data training, data annotation, QA, software testing, or research tasks is helpful but not required.

title: Machine Learning (ML) AI Task Auditor - Freelance AI Trainer Project
descriptionHtml:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Machine Learning (ML) AI Task Auditor - Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Saudi Arabia.

This freelance opportunity is designed for experienced Machine Learning professionals who want to apply their technical expertise to the development and evaluation of advanced AI systems.

You will audit machine learning tasks used to train and evaluate AI models, ensuring they are technically accurate, realistic, reproducible, and practical.

The role involves reviewing model development workflows, data preprocessing pipelines, algorithms, and testing approaches against rigorous technical standards.

You will identify data pipeline flaws, model training inefficiencies, algorithmic logic errors, and other issues that could affect task quality.

Your feedback will help improve the reliability and technical integrity of AI training and evaluation workflows.

The project offers a flexible, remote environment where specialized machine learning expertise can directly influence the quality of AI systems.

As a freelance contributor, you will work independently on challenging technical assignments while helping ensure AI evaluation tasks reflect real-world machine learning practices.

Accountabilities

  • Evaluate machine learning tasks to determine whether they are technically accurate, realistic, solvable, reproducible, and supported by reliable tests and evaluation criteria.
  • Review model development workflows, data preprocessing pipelines, and machine learning implementations for technical correctness and practical relevance.
  • Assess whether algorithms, training approaches, and expected outcomes are logically sound and appropriately defined.
  • Identify data pipeline flaws, model training inefficiencies, algorithmic logic errors, and other technical issues that may compromise task quality.
  • Rigorously test and troubleshoot complex machine learning scenarios to validate task behavior and expected results.
  • Provide clear, actionable technical feedback on identified issues and recommend improvements where appropriate.
  • Apply specialized machine learning knowledge to ensure AI training and evaluation tasks meet high standards of accuracy, rigor, and reproducibility.
  • Document technical findings clearly and consistently across assigned project tasks.

Requirements

  • Demonstrable professional experience and deep technical knowledge in Machine Learning, including model development and data preprocessing pipelines.
  • Strong hands-on experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms, model training workflows, data preparation, and technical evaluation practices.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to rigorously test, troubleshoot, and evaluate complex technical scenarios.
  • Excellent attention to detail and the ability to identify subtle data, model, algorithmic, testing, and reproducibility issues.
  • Ability to objectively assess technical tasks against requirements for accuracy, realism, solvability, and reliable evaluation.
  • Strong written communication skills for providing precise, constructive, and actionable technical feedback.
  • Ability to work independently and apply specialized expertise within a freelance, project-based environment.
  • Candidates will be considered for one area of specialization based on their professional experience; expertise across other domains is not required.
  • Ability to provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection for freelance project work.

Benefits

  • Compensation of $70–$100 per hour, with the exact rate determined based on experience, expertise, and geographic location.
  • Final compensation may vary from the published range following evaluation of your qualifications and location.
  • Freelance contract structure offering flexibility for project-based work.
  • Remote work environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute directly to the training and evaluation of advanced AI systems.
  • Opportunity to apply specialized Machine Learning expertise to technically challenging AI evaluation projects.
  • Health insurance, paid time off, and other company-sponsored employee benefits are not provided under the freelance contract.
  • Contractors are responsible for supplying their own secure computer and high-speed internet connection.

How Jobgether Works

We use an AI-powered matching process to ensure your application is reviewed quickly, objectively, and fairly against the role's core requirements. Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

Why Apply Through Jobgether?

Data Privacy Notice: By submitting your application, you acknowledge that Jobgether will process your personal data to evaluate your candidacy and share relevant information with the hiring employer. This processing is based on legitimate interest and pre-contractual measures under applicable data protection laws (including GDPR). You may exercise your rights (access, rectification, erasure, objection) at any time.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: AI/ML Computational Scientist Manager
descriptionHtml:
YOU ARE

As an AI/ML Computational Scientist, you will design, build, and operationalize artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions for enterprise clients, combining custom models with cloud and third-party AI services to deliver production-ready outcomes. Your role spans the full solution lifecycle — assessing client needs and data, selecting and customizing models (including Deep Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models), designing scalable data and MLOps/LLMOps pipelines for training and production, and ensuring quality, value, and reliability of deployed systems.

THE WORK


  • Formulate real-world problems into practical, efficient, and scalable AI and Machine Learning solutions
  • Develop and implement machine learning algorithms, models, and computational systems; design and build scalable data pipelines to support model training and production with DevOps & MLOps
  • Customize and apply Deep Learning and Gen AI models for various use cases based on the business needs, data availability, system and infrastructure requirements - including edge device and HPC
  • Engage in research and development of new AI and high-performance compute algorithms, models, and simulations along with their applications to solve complex business problems at client sites
  • Work with large-scale datasets and utilize data preprocessing techniques to ensure high-quality input for training and production
  • Implement and maintain efficient data storage and retrieval mechanisms for models and knowledge using appropriate tools
  • Justify the value of model approaches in business problems
  • Collaborate with teams from both business and technical sides, including users, use case representatives, business owners, engineers, architects, and UI designers, to achieve end-to-end project goals and integrate into production


    • EDUCATION



  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent


    • Basic (required) Qualification


  • Proven experience as a machine learning engineer or scientist, deploying models in production at scale , including monitoring, alerting, automatic bug filing and auditing.
  • Considerable experience in applying theoretical foundations of computer science, including computer system architecture, system engineering, and programming
  • experience in distributed computing systems and architecture that may include big data, high-performance compute, engineering simulations, scientific compute, grid and cloud computing, distributed networks
  • experience in building and deploying AI/ML based software to a cloud environment.


    • Preferred Qualification


  • Proficiency in Python and python-based AI/ML framework and familiarity with relevant libraries and frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)..
  • Experience working with language models like LLM's APIs and optimizing their usage for specific applications.
  • Experience with the following programming languages: Python, C++, Java, R, SQL
  • Strong written & verbal communication skills and ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Strong client-facing skillsets in a consulting environment
  • Strong cross-functional skills with the ability to collaborate with a variety of internal and client-side teams
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a curiosity and passion for emergent tech and driving innovation
  • MS or PhD in related field preferred (computer science, engineering, etc.)

title: AI Integration Engineer
descriptionHtml:
AI Integration Engineer


We are seeking a qualified AI Integration Engineer to join a dynamic team within the AI & Data function. The successful candidate will play a key role in developing high-performance backend services and integrating AI solutions with internal systems and third-party platforms.


Position Details


Position Title: AI Integration Engineer

Department: AI Innovation Solution

Function: AI & Data


Job Purpose


The AI Integration Engineer will be responsible for developing high-performance backend services using Python and Node.js, while ensuring adherence to clean coding and secure development standards. The role involves designing, documenting, and maintaining robust APIs including RESTful and SOAP services for both internal platforms and external third-party integrations.


The engineer will implement secure authentication mechanisms, caching layers such as Redis and Memcached, and containerized deployments on Kubernetes environments (OKE) to ensure high availability, scalability, and low-latency operations. The role also requires close collaboration with frontend, data engineering, and DevOps teams to deliver reliable end-to-end solutions.


Key Responsibilities

• Design, document, and maintain backend AI integration solutions including RESTful and SOAP APIs.

• Ensure adherence to technical standards, secure coding practices, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Oversee data ingestion, cleaning, and labeling processes to ensure data quality before model training.

• Coordinate model testing and validation, including functional, performance, and bias testing.

• Support production deployment processes and ensure proper rollback and release procedures.

• Monitor system performance and maintain monitoring dashboards to detect drift and trigger retraining workflows when required.


Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

• 3–7 years of experience developing high-performance backend services.

• Strong hands-on experience with Python and Node.js.

• Proven experience building and maintaining RESTful and SOAP APIs.

• Experience implementing OAuth 2.0, JWT, and role-based access control for secure integrations.

• Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and scalable backend architectures.

• Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.


Key Skills

• Backend Development (Python, Node.js)

• API Engineering (RESTful & SOAP)

• Authentication & Authorization (OAuth 2.0, JWT)

• Containerization and Deployment (Docker, Kubernetes, OKE)

• Performance Optimization (Redis, Memcached)

• Monitoring and System Reliability

• Agile Collaboration with cross-functional teams
