title: Agent Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

Role Overview

As an Agent Engineer, you will work closely with our engineering, product, and client-facing teams to design, build, and deploy AI agents that solve real-world problems. You'll support Proof of Concept (POC) development, own the end-to-end delivery of agent implementations, and interface directly with clients — gaining hands-on experience in one of the most in-demand areas of modern AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development of Proof of Concepts (POCs) for new client use cases, from scoping through to demo-ready delivery.
  • Design and build AI agents using our platform, translating client requirements into functional agent workflows.
  • Own end-to-end delivery of agent implementations — taking responsibility for timelines, quality, and outcomes.
  • Interface with clients to gather requirements, present progress, answer questions, and manage expectations throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Listen to recorded calls between AI agents and customers, evaluating each interaction for accuracy, tone, compliance, and customer experience.
  • Score conversations against a defined quality rubric and document findings in our QA tracking system.
  • Flag agent errors, hallucinations, missed customer cues, and policy or compliance issues for the team to address.
  • Identify patterns and trends across calls — recurring failure modes, common customer questions, and opportunities to improve agent prompts and workflows.
  • Partner with the Operations team to share feedback that informs agent training, prompt updates, and product improvements.
  • Help refine and evolve the QA rubric and scoring guidelines as our agents grow and change.
  • Contribute to weekly quality reports summarizing performance metrics, key issues, and recommended improvements.
  • Occasionally review chat or text-based agent transcripts in addition to voice calls.

Requirements

  • Basic understanding of software testing concepts and methodologies
  • Familiarity with testing tools or programming languages is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and analytical abilities
  • Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to speak and write fluently in both Arabic & English
  • Must be based in Riyadh

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up
  • Collaborative, mission-driven culture
  • Hands-on experience working on impactful AI products

title: AI/ML Engineer - Industrial Analytics
descriptionHtml:
Job Title – AI/ML Engineer - Industrial Analytics

Company – TCS (MEA)

Location – Riyadh, Saudi Arabia(KSA)

Job type – Full time


About Us:

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions. This is delivered through its unique Location Independent Agile™ delivery model, recognized as a benchmark of excellence in software development.

A part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS has over 616,171 of the world’s best-trained consultants with 157 nationalities in 53 countries. For more information, visit www.tcs.com and follow TCS news at @TCS_News.


Job Description:


Desired Competencies (Technical / Behavioral):


Must-Have:


· Designed, developed, and deployed Machine Learning and Deep Learning models for industrial challenges involving large-scale numerical, categorical, and time series data, as well as images and videos.

· Extensive experience in Python programming for statistical analysis, custom algorithm development, and business insight generation using ML/DL models.

· Proficient in optimization techniques including Genetic Algorithms, Linear and Quadratic Programming, and others.

· Skilled in comprehensive data workflows: collection, exploratory analytics, data cleansing, feature selection, and model validation.

· Experience in deploying AI/ML solutions using MLOPs on cloud platforms such as Azure and AWS. · Solid knowledge of NLP, Large Language Models, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, and ML algorithms such as Decision Trees, Clustering, Support Vector Machines, Artificial Neural Networks, LSTM, CNN, and YOLO, with awareness of their practical advantages and limitations.

· Motivated by continuous learning and mastery of emerging technologies and methodologies in the fields of artificial intelligence and machine learning.


Good-to-Have :


· Experience in Oil & Gas, refinery, asset monitoring or other process industries.

· Exposure to GenAI, AI agents, RAG, knowledge graphs or hybrid physics-ML modelling.

· Knowledge of MLOps platforms, drift detection and responsible AI practices.


Application Deadline: 10-October-2026

descriptionHtml:

Role Overview

As a Product Engineer, you will work closely with the Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to understand client requirements, design and build tailored solutions, and bring them to life using Sarj AI’s products and capabilities. title: Staff AI Researcher
descriptionHtml:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

Join Lenovo's Group CTO KSA RD Center as an AI Research Scientist, where you'll help shape the next generation of intelligent systems across robotics, autonomous platforms, smart environments, and industrial AI. In this role, you will research, develop, and deploy advanced AI solutions spanning computer vision, multimodal AI, agentic architectures, and Edge AI, transforming innovative ideas into scalable, real-world technologies that power the future of intelligent automation.

What You Will Do

  • Research, develop, and optimize AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agentic AI solutions for real-world applications.
  • Design perception systems including object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, pose estimation, and recognition.
  • Build AI capabilities for robotics and autonomous systems, including localization, sensor fusion, navigation, prediction, and decision-making.
  • Develop and integrate LLMs, VLMs, multimodal models, and AI agents to enable intelligent reasoning and human-machine interaction.
  • Deploy and optimize AI models across edge and cloud environments, balancing performance, scalability, latency, and cost.
  • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and foundation models, creating prototypes, benchmarks, and performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with global research, engineering, and product teams to transform research into production-ready solutions, patents, and intellectual property.

Who You Are

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning, computer vision, or agentic AI solutions from research through production.
  • Strong expertise in computer vision techniques, including detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, and sensor fusion.
  • Hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, and modern AI/ML development frameworks.
  • Experience working with LLMs, VLMs, multimodal AI, foundation models, and autonomous AI systems.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, with experience in C++ and AI deployment on edge or cloud platforms.

What We Can Offer You

  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI, robotics, and intelligent systems with global impact.
  • A collaborative RD environment focused on innovation, research excellence, and emerging technologies.
  • Career growth opportunities through advanced research, patent creation, and participation in Lenovo's global AI ecosystem.

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

Join Lenovo's Group CTO KSA RD Center as an AI Research Scientist, where you'll help shape the next generation of intelligent systems across robotics, autonomous platforms, smart environments, and industrial AI. In this role, you will research, develop, and deploy advanced AI solutions spanning computer vision, multimodal AI, agentic architectures, and Edge AI, transforming innovative ideas into scalable, real-world technologies that power the future of intelligent automation.

What You Will Do



- Research, develop, and optimize AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agentic AI solutions for real-world applications.
- Design perception systems including object detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, pose estimation, and recognition.
- Build AI capabilities for robotics and autonomous systems, including localization, sensor fusion, navigation, prediction, and decision-making.
- Develop and integrate LLMs, VLMs, multimodal models, and AI agents to enable intelligent reasoning and human-machine interaction.
- Deploy and optimize AI models across edge and cloud environments, balancing performance, scalability, latency, and cost.
- Evaluate emerging AI technologies and foundation models, creating prototypes, benchmarks, and performance metrics.
- Collaborate with global research, engineering, and product teams to transform research into production-ready solutions, patents, and intellectual property.

Who You Are



- Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Mathematics, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience developing and deploying machine learning, computer vision, or agentic AI solutions from research through production.
- Strong expertise in computer vision techniques, including detection, classification, segmentation, tracking, and sensor fusion.
- Hands-on experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, and modern AI/ML development frameworks.
- Experience working with LLMs, VLMs, multimodal AI, foundation models, and autonomous AI systems.
- Strong programming skills in Python, with experience in C++ and AI deployment on edge or cloud platforms.

What We Can Offer You



- The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI, robotics, and intelligent systems with global impact.
- A collaborative RD environment focused on innovation, research excellence, and emerging technologies.
- Career growth opportunities through advanced research, patent creation, and participation in Lenovo's global AI ecosystem.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

title: AI/ML Automation Analyst
companyName: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role


The AI/ML Support Automation Analyst will be a key member of the KSL AI Support Team, focusing on MLOps infrastructure, container orchestration, and workflow automation at a supercomputing scale.

This role is responsible for developing and maintaining secure, OCI-compliant container images, robust CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native MLOps workflows that enable researchers to efficiently deploy and manage AI/ML workloads. The Analyst will bridge the gap between cutting-edge Kubernetes-based infrastructure and the diverse needs of the research community, contributing to governance, technical enablement, and community development initiatives.


Responsibilities


MLOps and Container Development

  • Providing timely and useful user support via telephone, walk-in, email, and ticketing system submissions for all types of inquiries.
  • Maintain high customer service standards in dealing with and responding to user issues and questions.
  • Develop and maintain secure, OCI-compliant, and HPC-ready AI/ML and data science software container images.
  • Design and implement robust MLOps workflows and pipelines at supercomputing scale.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for reproducible infrastructure and workflow deployment.
  • Design and deploy APIs for AI/ML services and inference endpoints.
  • Implement and manage Kubernetes-based orchestration, including CNI, CSI, and service mesh configurations and optimization.
  • Deploy and maintain container registries (Harbor) and model registries (MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry).


Governance and Compliance Support

  • Assist in computational readiness reviews for AI research projects.
  • Assist in AI model and artifact control reviews to ensure compliance with institutional standards.
  • Provide consultation to users on efficient resource usage for AI/ML and MLOps workflows.
  • Ensure container images and workflows comply with security policies and best practices.
  • Support the implementation of usage monitoring and reporting systems.


Performance and Benchmarking

  • Perform performance debugging and tuning of MLOps and cloud-native workflows.
  • Develop and maintain AI/ML and MLOps workload benchmarks for procuring new systems.
  • Create and maintain regression testing workloads for existing clusters.
  • Deploy and maintain observability and resource monitoring stacks using Prometheus, Grafana, NVIDIA DCGM, and Grafana Loki.
  • Contribute to technology evaluation and benchmarking exercises for future infrastructure investments.


Training and Documentation

  • Create comprehensive training content for users on MLOps platforms, Kubernetes, and containerization.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality user documentation for automation tools and workflows.
  • Support the delivery of workshops on CI/CD, container orchestration, and MLOps best practices.
  • Contribute to knowledge transfer initiatives within the KAUST research community.
  • Provide one-on-one consultation to researchers on efficient use of automation infrastructure.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Computational Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • Certifications such as CKA (Certified Kubernetes Administrator), CKAD (Certified Kubernetes Application Developer), CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), or CNPE (Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineer) are highly valued.


Required Skills


  • Demonstrated experience developing robust and complex MLOps pipelines.
  • Hands-on experience with API design and deployment.
  • Experience developing robust and portable CI/CD pipelines for reproducible infrastructure and workflow deployment.
  • Experience supporting researchers or working in academic/research computing settings preferred.


Technical Skills - Essential

  • Kubernetes: Strong expertise in Kubernetes, Container Network Interface (CNI), Container Storage Interface (CSI), and Service Mesh.
  • MLOps: Experience developing and maintaining MLOps pipelines and workflows.
  • CI/CD: Proficiency in building CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and application deployment.
  • Containerization: Experience building secure, OCI-compliant container images.
  • API Development: Experience in API design, development, and deployment.
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python; experience with Go, Bash scripting.
  • Linux: Strong Linux/Unix systems administration skills.


Technical Skills - Desired

  • Experience with ArgoCD, Airflow, DASK, Spark for workflow orchestration.
  • Experience with Kubeflow, KServe, and Seldon for ML serving and pipelines.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, NVIDIA DCGM, Grafana Loki).
  • Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agentic frameworks.
  • Experience deploying inference services at scale.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining container registries (Harbor) and model registries (MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry, Artifact Hub).
  • Experience with GitOps practices and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Experience with HPC schedulers (SLURM) and HPC-cloud integration.

About Us:

Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world’s largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions. This is delivered through its unique Location Independent Agile™ delivery model, recognized as a benchmark of excellence in software development.

A part of the Tata group, India's largest multinational business group, TCS has over 616,171 of the world’s best-trained consultants with 157 nationalities in 53 countries. For more information, visit www.tcs.com and follow TCS news at @TCS_News.


Job Description:


Objective:

To develop future-ready Saudi talent in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Governance, Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC), Enterprise Integration, and Modern Data Platforms.


Program Goal:

Build skilled professionals capable of supporting enterprise AI, analytics, data quality, metadata management, API integration, cloud data engineering, and digital trans.


AI & Machine Learning:

Assist in developing AI/ML models, data preparation, feature engineering, model evaluation, and AI use-case implementation.


Data Governance:

Support data quality monitoring, business glossary creation, metadata management, data cataloging, stewardship activities, and data lineage documentation.


Informatica Platform:

Assist in Informatica IDMC, Data Quality (DQ), Data Catalog, Metadata Management, Data Governance, and Data Integration activities. Integration Layer Participate in API development, ETL/ELT processes, data migration, system integrations, and orchestration workflows.


Data Engineering:

Support data ingestion, transformation, validation, analytics, and reporting initiatives.


Analytics & Reporting:

Develop dashboards, reports, and KPIs using modern analytics tools.


Data Quality:

Analyze data issues, create quality rules, monitor anomalies, and support remediation activities.


Documentation:

Prepare process documents, technical specifications, architecture diagrams, and SOPs.


Innovation:

Participate in AI/GenAI hackathons, POCs, innovation programs, and automation initiatives.


Collaboration:

Work with business users, architects, data scientists, governance teams, and integration specialists.


Application Deadline: 30-September-2026

title: Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We help the world run better

At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

What You'll Build

In this role, you contribute to the design, development, and operation of AI-native enterprise applications within fast-moving, customer-embedded delivery teams. You bring solid engineering fundamentals and a growing command of AI and machine learning techniques, applying them to solve real-world business problems under the guidance of senior engineers and technical leads. This is a role for someone early in their AI engineering career who is hungry to learn, eager to contribute, and excited by the challenge of building production-grade solutions that make a tangible difference for enterprise customers.

In This Role, You Will

  • Contribute to the development of production-grade, cloud-native applications integrating AI capabilities such as large language models, RAG pipelines, and agent-based components.
  • Work within customer projects and cross-functional delivery teams, learning to understand business processes, technical landscapes, and customer needs.
  • Implement features, components, and integrations under the guidance of senior engineers, maintaining code quality and adherence to engineering standards.
  • Support prototyping, testing, and iteration of AI solutions in customer environments, adapting to feedback and evolving requirements.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, and design sessions, actively developing your engineering skills and knowledge.
  • Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting, and improving deployed solutions to ensure reliability and operational stability.
  • Contribute to documentation, reusable components, and engineering best practices to support team productivity and knowledge sharing.
  • Demonstrate a proactive learning mindset — staying current with AI/ML developments and applying new techniques and tools to improve solution quality.

What You Bring

  • Solid foundational skills in software engineering, with proficiency in Python and hands-on experience in at least one cloud-native development environment.
  • Growing understanding of AI and ML concepts, including familiarity with large language models, machine learning frameworks (e.g. TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn), and API-based AI services.
  • Exposure to data pipelines, MLOps concepts, or AI/ML model integration in application contexts.
  • Ability to work collaboratively within a team, follow engineering standards, and take ownership of assigned tasks with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and a growth mindset — you actively seek feedback, learn from experience, and are motivated to grow quickly in a high-pace environment.
  • Basic understanding of cloud platforms (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP) and familiarity with tools such as Git, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within cross-functional teams and customer-facing settings.
  • An interest in or early exposure to SAP AI technologies such as SAP AI Core or SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is a plus.

Where You Belong

You will be part of a growing AI and industry expert team serving customers across the Americas, Europe, and Asia. We invest in the growth of our people at every level — and this role is built for someone who wants to accelerate fast. You will be surrounded by experienced engineers and AI practitioners who are committed to helping you develop. You will thrive here if you are curious, hardworking, and motivated by the opportunity to build real AI solutions for real enterprise customers — from day one.

#SAPIndustryAICareers

Bring out your best

SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion

SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

SAP is committed to the values of Equal Employment Opportunity and provides accessibility accommodations to applicants with physical and/or mental disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with SAP and are in need of accommodation or special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please send an e-mail with your request to Recruiting Operations Team: Careers@sap.com.

For SAP employees: Only permanent roles are eligible for the SAP Employee Referral Program, according to the eligibility rules set in the SAP Referral Policy. Specific conditions may apply for roles in Vocational Training.

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, race, religion, national origin, ethnicity, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, et al), sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, protected veteran status, or disability, in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Successful candidates might be required to undergo a background verification with an external vendor.

AI Usage in the Recruitment Process

For information on the responsible use of AI in our recruitment process, please refer to our Guidelines for Ethical Usage of AI in the Recruiting Process.

Please note that any violation of these guidelines may result in disqualification from the hiring process.

• SAP Business AI Platform brings together AI, data, process context, and governance, so organizations can build, integrate, scale, and run AI. 
• SAP also offers 25+ Industry AI editions embedded in sector-specific processes and compliance requirements across pharma, automotive, consumer goods, energy, and more.  
• RISE with SAP and SAP GROW help organizations move to the cloud and benefit from AI at their own pace.  

Our partners amplify SAP’s value through solution innovation, deep product expertise, world-class services, and more.

title: Data Scientist - AI and Data Science Engineer I
descriptionHtml:
Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As an AI and Data Science Engineer I on the AI & Data team, you will:

  • Develop and sustain operational technology cyber data ontologies that support analytics, detection, and reporting use cases
  • Build, train, test, and maintain machine learning models for operational technology cyber threat and attack detection
  • Design and maintain data pipelines that move sensor and telemetry data from on-premises environments to cloud platforms
  • Analyze cyber data to identify patterns, anomalies, and indicators that support security operations and mission objectives
  • Collaborate with technical leads, delivery teams, security operations center stakeholders, cloud and data teams, and program management to implement scalable analytics solutions

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice - our people, ideas, technology and outcomes - is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Active Secret security clearance required
  • 1+ years of experience with data modeling, Jira, machine learning, Python, and SQL
  • Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting operational technology cybersecurity analytics use cases
  • Experience developing and maintaining machine learning models in production environments
  • Experience designing data pipelines across on-premises and cloud-connected environments
  • Experience analyzing cyber data to identify anomalies, patterns, and indicators
  • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders across delivery, security operations, cloud, and program management teams

title: Data Scientist I
descriptionHtml:
About Mozn

MOZN is a leading Enterprise AI company enabling organizations to make informed decisions in two critical domains: Financial Crime Prevention and Enterprise Knowledge Intelligence.

We're a diverse, collaborative team of innovators united by a shared purpose: to build AI that delivers tangible business value, builds trust, and empowers people and organizations with augmented intelligence. Our culture is built on the relentless pursuit of excellence and meaningful impact.

If you're passionate about working alongside exceptional talent on world-class AI, and you want the autonomy and runway to do the best work of your career, join us in shaping the future of intelligent enterprises.

About the role

The Mozn brand is alive within a plethora of stakeholder touchpoints and therefore the most suitable candidate for the Data Scientist I position would have an interest in Financial Fraud Detection, Sanction Screening, Know Your Customer (KYC) procedures, Anti-Money Laundering (AML) initiatives, and emerging Generative AI technologies. As a Data Scientist I, you will support the development of analytical and AI-driven solutions to help detect and prevent fraudulent activities and mitigate AML risks under close guidance.

What you'll do

  • Support the development of fraud detection, AML, and Generative AI use cases
  • Assist in building and testing ML and GenAI models (e.g., prompt engineering, RAG pipelines)
  • Prepare, clean, and analyze structured and unstructured data
  • Support the training, evaluation, and deployment of ML models
  • Assist with experimentation using LLMs for tasks such as document analysis, alert summarization, or data enrichment
  • Execute assigned tasks within project plans under supervision
  • Stay informed about industry trends related to fraud, AML, and Generative AI

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Science, AI, Machine Learning, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field
  • 0-2 years of experience in data science or analytics
  • Basic understanding of ML concepts and exposure to Generative AI or LLMs
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python
  • Experience with data extraction, cleaning, and basic visualization
  • Familiarity with model evaluation and feature engineering concepts
  • Proficiency in English; Arabic is a plus
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn

Benefits

  • You will be at the forefront of an exciting time for the Middle East, joining a high-growth rocket-ship in an exciting space
  • You will be given a lot of responsibility and trust. We believe that the best results come when the people responsible for a function are given the freedom to do what they think is best
  • The fundamentals will be taken care of: competitive compensation, top-tier health insurance, and an enabling culture so that you can focus on what you do best
  • You will enjoy a fun and dynamic workplace working alongside some of the greatest minds in AI
  • We believe strength lies in difference, embracing all for who they are and empowered to be the best version of themselves

title: Associate AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location:  Hybrid, United States

Employment Type: Full-Time

Benefits Offered: Vision, Medical, Life, Dental, 401K

Gross Annual Base Salary: USD 86,000 - 115,000

Additional variable compensation and benefits may apply. Total compensation is based on experience, skills, and location using objective, job-related criteria.

This role requires the candidate to work from one of the following OneStream office locations: Birmingham, MI, Fort Lauderdale, FL, New York, NY, or Chicago, IL.

Summary

As an Associate AI Engineer you will be a critical member in executing our AI initiatives within the OneStream platform. The AI Product and Engineering team is focused on bridging the gap between AI research and AI products, bringing tangible and quantifiable value to our end users. Our AI solutions incorporate applications across the AI and machine learning spectrum, including (but not limited to) time series forecasting, anomaly detection, and natural language processing. Our mission is to lower the barrier for organizations and people to get value out of AI capabilities.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable, high-performance applications and services using a variety of software architecture design patterns.
  • Implement robust software systems and functionalities using Python and SQL/NoSQL, ensuring optimal performance and scalability.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues across the full stack, from the user interface to the database layer.
  • Participate in technical design sessions to decompose and design complex systems and interfaces.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure technical and user requirements are met.
  • Must be a self-starter, continuously be learning both best code practices and the latest technologies in the Software ecosystem.
  • Must understand data analysis and how to apply data science solutions into end products.

Required Education And Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree or similar work experience.
  • CS/EE/CE Degree or similar experience.
  • 1-2 years of experience building and deploying production-level machine learning solutions or similar experience.
  • 1-2 years of strong programming experience with one of the following: Python, C++, C, CSharp, Java, Rust, or Go (or similar experience).

Preferred Education And Experience

  • Experience building and deploying production-level software solutions or similar experience.
  • Experience with webservices and API frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, etc.).
  • Experience with relational or non-relational databases (MS SQL Server).
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and cloud-based computing (Azure).
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Sklearn).

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Self-Starter to decompose a problem and plan a solution.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to changes in technology and the business environment.
  • Highly adaptive to changing circumstances, with the ability to tackle problems quickly.
  • Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organization, scheduling, project management and multi-tasking skills.
  • Ability to write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
  • Interest in continuous learning opportunities as the software landscape continues to evolve.
  • Capable and comfortable effectively presenting in front of your peers.
  • Proficient in effectively prioritizing and executing tasks in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
  • Highly self-motivated and proactive.
  • Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail.
  • Comfortable engaging and presenting to C-level executives from time to time.
  • Employee must be legally authorized to work in the country of the job position as a precondition of employment.

Travel

Minimal travel required.

Who We Are

OneStream is how today’s Finance teams can go beyond just reporting on the past and Take Finance Further™ by steering the business to the future. It’s the only enterprise finance platform that unifies financial and operational data, embeds AI for better decisions and productivity, and empowers the CFO to become a critical driver of business strategy and execution.    Our vision is to be the AI operating system for modern finance, digitizing core financial functions and empowering the CFO to become a critical driver of business strategy. To learn more visit www.onestream.com.

Why Join the OneStream Team

  • Transparency around corporate structure, salary, and benefits
  • Core value of customer success
  • Variety of project work (not industry specific)
  • Strong culture and camaraderie
  • Multiple training opportunities

Benefits At OneStream

OneStream employees are passionate, hardworking individuals who go above and beyond to keep our customers happy and follow through on our mission statement. They consistently deliver the best and in turn, we make every effort to keep them cared for and happy. A sample of the benefits we provide are:

  • Excellent Medical Plan
  • Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Short & Long Term Disability
  • Vacation Time
  • Paid Holidays
  • Professional Development
  • Retirement Plan

All candidates must be legally authorized to work for any company in the country where this position is located without sponsorship.

OneStream is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are

At Synechron, we believe in the power of digital to transform businesses for the better. Our global consulting firm combines creativity and innovative technology to deliver industry-leading digital solutions. Synechron’s progressive technologies and optimization strategies span end-to-end Artificial Intelligence, Consulting, Digital, Cloud & DevOps, Data, and Software Engineering, servicing an array of noteworthy financial services and technology firms. Through research and development initiatives in our FinLabs we develop solutions for modernization, from Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain to Data Science models, Digital Underwriting, mobile-first applications and more. Over the last 20+ years, our company has been honored with multiple employer awards, recognizing our commitment to our talented teams. With top clients to boast about, Synechron has a global workforce of 14,500+, and has 58 offices in 21 countries within key global markets.


Additional Information*

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors. In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within New Jersey $65k - $68k/year & benefits (see below).


About the Role

We are looking for a curious, disciplined, and highly motivated Entry-Level AI Engineer to join our team. This role is designed for someone at the beginning of their engineering career who is excited to learn, solve difficult problems, and build practical AI systems.

You do not need prior professional experience in artificial intelligence. We care more about your ability to think rigorously, learn unfamiliar concepts, write clear and maintainable code, and follow through on challenging work. You will receive guidance and collaborate with experienced engineers while developing your skills across machine learning, software engineering, data, and AI products.


What You’ll Do

  • Build, test, and improve AI and machine learning features.
  • Write clean, reliable, and well-documented Python code.
  • Work with data to prepare, analyze, and validate datasets.
  • Implement and evaluate machine learning models and AI workflows.
  • Experiment with large language models, APIs, embeddings, or other AI technologies.
  • Design tests and use evidence to evaluate whether a system is working well.
  • Debug technical problems systematically.
  • Read technical documentation, research papers, and unfamiliar codebases.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other team members.
  • Document your work, assumptions, results, and next steps.
  • Continuously learn new tools, methods, and concepts as the field evolves.


What We’re Looking For

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Rigor and attention to detail.
  • Discipline and the ability to consistently complete work.
  • A genuine willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies.
  • Ability to break complex problems into smaller, testable steps.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Comfort receiving feedback and improving your work.
  • Ability to work independently while asking thoughtful questions when needed.
  • A solid foundation in programming, especially Python, through coursework, projects, internships, research, or self-directed learning.


Helpful, but Not Required

  • Familiarity with machine learning or deep learning concepts.
  • Experience with Python libraries such as NumPy, pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
  • Exposure to SQL, APIs, Git, Linux, cloud platforms, or software testing.
  • Experience building personal, academic, open-source, or hackathon projects.
  • Familiarity with probability, statistics, linear algebra, or calculus.
  • A GitHub portfolio, technical project, research project, or other demonstration of your work.


Education

  • A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related field is welcome but not required.
  • Equivalent skills gained through projects, bootcamps, independent study, military service, or other experiences are also valued.


What Success Looks Like

During your first several months, you will be expected to:

  • Learn the team’s development practices and technical stack.
  • Deliver small, well-tested engineering tasks.
  • Explain your reasoning and document your work clearly.
  • Make steady progress on unfamiliar problems.
  • Respond constructively to feedback.
  • Develop a reliable understanding of how our AI systems are built, tested, and maintained.


We offer:

  • A highly competitive compensation and benefits package.
  • A multinational organization with 58 offices in 21 countries and the possibility to work abroad.

The base salary for this position will vary based on geography and other factors. In accordance with law, the base salary for this role if filled within New Jersey $65k - $68k/year & benefits (see below).


About the Role
We are looking for a curious, disciplined, and highly motivated Entry-Level AI Engineer to join our team. This role is designed for someone at the beginning of their engineering career who is excited to learn, solve difficult problems, and build practical AI systems.
You do not need prior professional experience in artificial intelligence. We care more about your ability to think rigorously, learn unfamiliar concepts, write clear and maintainable code, and follow through on challenging work. You will receive guidance and collaborate with experienced engineers while developing your skills across machine learning, software engineering, data, and AI products.


What You’ll Do

- Build, test, and improve AI and machine learning features.

- Work with data to prepare, analyze, and validate datasets.

- Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and other team members.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Rigor and attention to detail.
- Discipline and the ability to consistently complete work.
- A genuine willingness to learn unfamiliar technologies.
- Ability to break complex problems into smaller, testable steps.
- Clear written and verbal communication.
- Comfort receiving feedback and improving your work.
- Ability to work independently while asking thoughtful questions when needed.

- Familiarity with machine learning or deep learning concepts.

- Experience building personal, academic, open-source, or hackathon projects.
- Familiarity with probability, statistics, linear algebra, or calculus.

Education

- A degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, statistics, or a related field is welcome but not required.
- Equivalent skills gained through projects, bootcamps, independent study, military service, or other experiences are also valued.

During your first several months, you will be expected to:

- Learn the team’s development practices and technical stack.
- Deliver small, well-tested engineering tasks.
- Explain your reasoning and document your work clearly.
- Make steady progress on unfamiliar problems.
- Respond constructively to feedback.
- Develop a reliable understanding of how our AI systems are built, tested, and maintained.

title: Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
What You Can Expect

In this role, you will design and ship AI-powered features within Zoom's Workforce Engagement Management (WEM) platform, directly improving how enterprise organizations forecast, schedule, and coach their teams. Working alongside experienced engineers, product managers, and data scientists, you will take ownership of features from initial design through production deployment. You will contribute to some of the most forward-looking work in the WEM space, from LLM-powered simulation environments to intelligent notification systems and AI-driven quality scoring pipelines. This is a hands-on role with meaningful mentorship from senior engineers and real impact on thousands of enterprise users from day one. This is a hybrid position that requires on-site presence 3 days per week at our San Jose, CA office. Remote arrangements are not available for this role.

About The Team

The Workforce Engagement Management team at Zoom builds intelligent systems that help organizations manage, forecast, and optimize workforce performance. Our suite of WFM and QM products sits at the intersection of AI and enterprise collaboration, and we are actively pioneering the use of generative AI and LLMs to shape the next generation of contact center experiences. We work at meaningful scale, with a culture that values curiosity, experimentation, and shared ownership.

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain AI-driven features for WFM and QM products using LLMs and prompt-based architectures.
  • Develop, fine-tune, and evaluate prompts and models for conversational and decision-support use cases.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to integrate AI capabilities into existing workflows and production systems.
  • Contribute to model evaluation frameworks and feedback loops that improve AI accuracy, reliability, and user experience.
  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and cross-functional syncs to ensure high-quality, scalable software delivery.
  • Identify and resolve production issues, contributing to root cause analysis and preventive measures.
  • Write clean, well-tested, and well-documented code following team engineering standards.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Strong programming skills in Python (preferred) or Go/Java, with foundational understanding of machine learning, NLP, or LLM architectures.
  • Familiarity with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or LangChain.
  • 0-1 years of professional software engineering experience; new graduates are welcome to apply.
  • Experience or coursework in prompt engineering, LLM fine-tuning, or AI workflow orchestration (internship or project experience counts).
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across functions.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure), containerized deployments (Docker/Kubernetes), or MLOps tooling is a plus.

Minimum

Salary Range or On Target Earnings:

$73,300.00

Maximum

$169,500.00

In addition to the base salary and/or OTE listed Zoom has a Total Direct Compensation philosophy that takes into consideration; base salary, bonus and equity value.

Note: Starting pay will be based on a number of factors and commensurate with qualifications & experience.

We also have a location based compensation structure; there may be a different range for candidates in this and other locations

At Zoom, we offer a window of at least 5 days for you to apply because we believe in giving you every opportunity. Below is the potential closing date, just in case you want to mark it on your calendar. We look forward to receiving your application!

Anticipated Position Close Date

09/17/26

Ways of Working

Our structured hybrid approach is centered around our offices and remote work environments. The work style of each role, Hybrid, Remote, or In-Person is indicated in the job description/posting.

Benefits

As part of our award-winning workplace culture and commitment to delivering happiness, our benefits program offers a variety of perks, benefits, and options to help employees maintain their physical, mental, emotional, and financial health; support work-life balance; and contribute to their community in meaningful ways. Click Learn for more information.

About Us

Zoomies help people stay connected so they can get more done together. We set out to build the best collaboration platform for the enterprise, and today help people communicate better with products like Zoom Contact Center, Zoom Phone, Zoom Events, Zoom Apps, Zoom Rooms, and Zoom Webinars.

We’re problem-solvers, working at a fast pace to design solutions with our customers and users in mind. Find room to grow with opportunities to stretch your skills and advance your career in a collaborative, growth-focused environment.

Our Commitment

At Zoom, we believe great work happens when people feel supported and empowered. We’re committed to fair hiring practices that ensure every candidate is evaluated based on skills, experience, and potential. If you require an accommodation during the hiring process, let us know—we’re here to support you at every step.

If you need assistance navigating the interview process due to a medical disability, please submit an Accommodations Request Form and someone from our team will reach out soon. This form is solely for applicants who require an accommodation due to a qualifying medical disability. Non-accommodation-related requests, such as application follow-ups or technical issues, will not be addressed.

Our interviews are supported by BrightHire, a tool that helps us create a consistent and thoughtful interview experience and may include recordings. Please refer to our candidate privacy statement for more information of how we use your data.

title: AI-ML Support Analyst
companyName: KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology)
descriptionHtml:
About the Role


The AI/ML Support Analyst will be a key member of the KAUST Supercomputing Lab’s (KSL) AI/ML Support Team, supporting the delivery of AI research services to KAUST's diverse research community. Working under the AI/ML Support Team Lead, this role focuses on developing and optimizing Generative AI models, maintaining computational benchmarks, and providing expert consultation to researchers across multiple scientific domains, including Climate & Weather, Bioinformatics, CFD, NLP, and multimodal AI. The analyst will help bridge the gap between cutting-edge computational infrastructure and the diverse needs of the research community, contributing to governance, technical enablement, and community development initiatives.


Responsibilities


Generative AI Development and Consulting

  • Providing timely and useful user support via telephone, walk-in, email, and ticketing system submissions for all types of inquiries.
  • Maintain high customer service standards in dealing with and responding to user issues and questions.
  • Develop and consult on large-scale Generative AI model training on domain-specific datasets across research areas including Climate & Weather, Bioinformatics, Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), NLP, and multimodal AI.
  • Support researchers in fine-tuning foundation models on domain-specific datasets using advanced optimization techniques.
  • Develop data engineering pipelines to support AI research workflows.
  • Design and implement efficient AI workflows optimized for KSL's high-performance computing environment.
  • Build and maintain secure, OCI-compliant, HPC-ready container images using Singularity, Podman, or similar.
  • Develop complex workflows using SLURM and Kubernetes for distributed training and inference.


Governance and Compliance Support

  • Conduct computational readiness reviews for AI research projects.
  • Assist in AI model and artifact control reviews to ensure compliance with institutional standards.
  • Support researchers in designing secure, compliant, and performant workflows.
  • Provide expert consultation to researchers on efficient utilization of AI resources and best practices.
  • Support the implementation of usage monitoring and reporting systems.
  • Ensure user workflows comply with KSL security policies and best practices.


Benchmarking and Quality Assurance

  • Develop and maintain computational benchmarks for AI workloads on KSL systems.
  • Create and maintain regression testing workloads to stress test system functionality.
  • Support performance debugging and optimization activities for research workloads.
  • Contribute to technology evaluation and benchmarking exercises for future infrastructure investments.
  • Perform benchmarking of new hardware and software configurations.


Training and Documentation

  • Create comprehensive training materials for end-users on KSL’s HPC systems hosting AI workloads and tools.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality technical documentation.
  • Support the delivery of workshops on distributed training, fine-tuning, and inference optimization.
  • Contribute to knowledge transfer initiatives within the KAUST research community.
  • Provide one-on-one consultation to researchers on efficient use of computational resources.


Qualifications


  • Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Computational Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
  • Strong academic foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and AI fundamentals.


Required Skills


  • Technical Skills - Essential
  • Programming: Proficiency in Python; experience with R, Julia, Rust or C/C++ is a plus.
  • AI/ML Frameworks: Strong expertise in PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, JAX or similar.
  • Generative AI: Experience with foundation model development and fine-tuning techniques.
  • HPC Systems: Experience developing complex workflows using SLURM and/or Kubernetes.
  • Containerization: Experience building efficient HPC-ready container images using Singularity, Podman or similar.
  • Data Engineering: Experience with data engineering techniques for developing AI pipelines.
  • Linux: Strong Linux/Unix skills and bash scripting capabilities.


Technical Skills - Desired

  • Experience with Cray EX supercomputers with NVIDIA GPUs.
  • Experience with Kubeflow pipelines and Kubeflow Training Operator.
  • Experience with distributed inference frameworks (NVIDIA Triton, NIM, SGLang, llama.cpp, llm-d, LLMcache).
  • Knowledge of security vulnerability inspection in software libraries, AI models, datasets, and pipelines.
  • Experience with software supply chain tools (JFrog, Nexus, Trivy, Cloudsmith).
  • Experience with data management on S3-compatible object storage at scale.
  • Experience with high-performance distributed filesystems (Lustre, Weka IO, VAST Data).
  • Proficiency with NVIDIA Nsight and Compute for profiling AI workloads on GPUs.
  • Experience developing CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, Travis, CircleCI, or similar tools.
  • Experience with software build tools (autoconf, CMake, scons, SPACK, EasyBuild, Conda, Pip).


Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Customer service mindset with patience for supporting diverse skill levels.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
  • Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices.
  • Cultural sensitivity for working in an international environment.

- Ensure user workflows comply with KSL security policies and best practices.


Benchmarking and Quality Assurance

- Develop and maintain computational benchmarks for AI workloads on KSL systems.
- Create and maintain regression testing workloads to stress test system functionality.
- Support performance debugging and optimization activities for research workloads.
- Contribute to technology evaluation and benchmarking exercises for future infrastructure investments.
- Perform benchmarking of new hardware and software configurations.


Training and Documentation

- Create comprehensive training materials for end-users on KSL’s HPC systems hosting AI workloads and tools.
- Develop and maintain high-quality technical documentation.
- Support the delivery of workshops on distributed training, fine-tuning, and inference optimization.
- Contribute to knowledge transfer initiatives within the KAUST research community.
- Provide one-on-one consultation to researchers on efficient use of computational resources.


Qualifications



- Bachelor's or master’s degree in computer science, Data Science, Computational Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field.
- Strong academic foundation in machine learning, deep learning, and AI fundamentals.


Required Skills



- Technical Skills - Essential
- Programming: Proficiency in Python; experience with R, Julia, Rust or C/C++ is a plus.
- AI/ML Frameworks: Strong expertise in PyTorch and/or TensorFlow, JAX or similar.
- Generative AI: Experience with foundation model development and fine-tuning techniques.
- HPC Systems: Experience developing complex workflows using SLURM and/or Kubernetes.
- Containerization: Experience building efficient HPC-ready container images using Singularity, Podman or similar.
- Data Engineering: Experience with data engineering techniques for developing AI pipelines.
- Linux: Strong Linux/Unix skills and bash scripting capabilities.


Technical Skills - Desired

- Experience with Cray EX supercomputers with NVIDIA GPUs.
- Experience with Kubeflow pipelines and Kubeflow Training Operator.
- Experience with distributed inference frameworks (NVIDIA Triton, NIM, SGLang, llama.cpp, llm-d, LLMcache).
- Knowledge of security vulnerability inspection in software libraries, AI models, datasets, and pipelines.
- Experience with software supply chain tools (JFrog, Nexus, Trivy, Cloudsmith).
- Experience with data management on S3-compatible object storage at scale.
- Experience with high-performance distributed filesystems (Lustre, Weka IO, VAST Data).
- Proficiency with NVIDIA Nsight and Compute for profiling AI workloads on GPUs.
- Experience developing CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, Travis, CircleCI, or similar tools.
- Experience with software build tools (autoconf, CMake, scons, SPACK, EasyBuild, Conda, Pip).


Soft Skills

- Strong problem-solving and analytical abilities.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
- Customer service mindset with patience for supporting diverse skill levels.
- Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.
- Strong documentation and knowledge-sharing practices.
- Cultural sensitivity for working in an international environment.

descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

Stellar Technologies is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer (GenAI) to design, build, and deploy next-generation AI systems combining Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and agentic AI frameworks.

In this role, you will bridge model development and production engineering — developing scalable AI pipelines, integrating real-time APIs, and ensuring high-performance AI services that power enterprise-grade solutions. You will work at the intersection of machine learning, cloud infrastructure, and applied research, collaborating with top engineers and data scientists to deliver intelligent, production-ready AI capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and optimize AI systems leveraging LLMs, RAG, and agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph).
  • Build and deploy production-grade ML pipelines with real-time inference and retrieval components.
  • Design and manage APIs and streaming services to integrate AI models into enterprise platforms.
  • Implement containerized, orchestrated deployments using Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure ML.
  • Automate data preprocessing, model training, evaluation, and versioning pipelines.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate models into front-end, analytics, and automation workflows.
  • Ensure governance, compliance, and security of deployed AI workloads.
  • Conduct performance benchmarking and optimize inference latency and cost.
  • Monitor AI systems in production using observability frameworks (logging, metrics, tracing).
  • Participate in architecture discussions to enhance scalability and reliability of AI services.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong hands-on experience with LLMs, RAG, and agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, etc.).
  • Proficiency in Python, with deep understanding of ML libraries like PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Solid experience in API and microservices engineering (FastAPI, Flask).
  • Familiarity with streaming architectures and real-time data handling.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure preferred), including Azure AI, Cognitive Services, and ML Ops.
  • Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Understanding of vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) and retrieval mechanisms.
  • Experience in CI/CD, model deployment, and production monitoring.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to GPU-based inference optimization and serverless deployment.
  • Knowledge of observability and monitoring tools for AI (Prometheus, Grafana, Azure Monitor).
  • Experience in model fine-tuning, prompt engineering, or agentic orchestration.
  • Understanding of AI governance, ethical AI, and data privacy frameworks.

Soft Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills.
  • Passion for innovation, experimentation, and applied AI.

Qualifications:

Career: Outstanding learning, development & growth opportunities via structured training programs and innovative, high-tech projects.

Rewards: A competitive remuneration package with a host of perks including healthcare, education support, leave benefits and more.

If you can confidently demonstrate that you meet the criteria above, please contact us as soon as possible.

title: AI / LLM Application Engineer
descriptionHtml:
AI / LLM Application Engineer


About the role

We're looking for an engineer to add governed AI features to an existing internal client-relationship/business-development platform, AI-assisted summaries, next-best-action suggestions, and drafted communications, all grounded in approved data, cited, and reviewed by a human before anything is sent. This is a controlled, compliance-conscious build for a regulated business environment, not an open-ended AI experiment.


What you'll build

  • RAG-based retrieval over approved internal content, with source citations, freshness flags, and missing-data warnings
  • AI-generated account summaries, meeting-prep briefs, and draft follow-ups (with mandatory human approval before anything goes out)
  • Versioning, audit logging, and an evaluation/testing process to catch quality regressions
  • Support for Arabic-language generation and translation
  • Deployment on private/client-controlled infrastructure (not standard cloud AI APIs)


Must-haves

  • 4+ years of production software engineering (Python and/or TypeScript)
  • 18+ months building AI/LLM features actually used by real users (not just demos or side projects)
  • Hands-on experience building RAG systems: ingestion, chunking, embeddings, retrieval, and citation of sources
  • Experience designing ways to test/evaluate AI output quality without a large labeled dataset
  • Experience with authentication, access control, logging, and human-approval workflows for sensitive data
  • Comfortable deploying AI systems on private/self-hosted infrastructure (not just calling a public AI API)


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with Arabic-language AI or right-to-left text handling
  • Background in banking, wealth/asset management, or other regulated industries


What's out of scope

  • No autonomous sending or external client-facing AI
  • No use of public cloud AI services (e.g., Azure OpenAI) , client data stays on approved infrastructure
  • No AI model training/fine-tuning from scratch


If you have what it takes to build this solution and are interested, hit that APPLY button!

Our Summer Internship Programme is an eight-week internship taking place June through August.

This programme is designed to provide students with a challenging, meaningful and supportive internship experience that replicates, as closely as possible, the experience of being a full-time BlackRock Analyst. The programme begins with an orientation that offers a thorough overview of the firm and the opportunity to hear from a number of senior leaders.

Following orientation, interns receive on-the-job training and are given day-to-day responsibilities to contribute to their teams throughout the summer. Programming also features a speaker series, mentoring and various networking opportunities, including activities with our employee networks.

If you enjoy this programme, you should explore our Full-Time Analyst Programme, which you can consider applying to after your internship.

Who can apply: Candidates should be in their penultimate year of studies and graduating from an undergraduate or a master’s

degree program in 2028. We welcome applications from candidates studying any degree subject.

Please note local language fluency is required to work at our Continental Europe locations. However, only English is required for Budapest or for a position within Private Markets Investing in Zurich

Important

Candidates can apply for only one programme (e.g., Summer Internship Programme or Quantitative Master’s Internship Programme) and up to two functions within that programme (e.g., Investment Research and Analytics & Modeling). You must apply for both opportunities using the same programme application.

If you withdraw your application, you cannot submit another application this program this year.

Next Steps

Once you submit your application, you will receive an email to complete a pre-interview assessment. You have up to five days to submit your pre-interview assessment; if you fail to do so, your application will be automatically withdrawn.

Application Deadlines

  • London, Edinburgh, Paris, Zurich – 30 September 2026
  • Milan, Amsterdam – 30 October 2026
  • Budapest, Belgrade, Frankfurt, Munich, Copenhagen – 13 November 2026
  • Abu Dhabi, Kuwait, Riyadh – 31 January 2027

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis so we encourage you to apply early.

We look forward to reviewing your application!

EU Pay Transparency Directive

View the EMEA 2027 Internship Salary Ranges document to view the salary ranges for applicable business areas and locations.

BlackRock is an Equal Opportunities Employer and is committed to hiring and treating all employees fairly.

title: AI/Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Position Summary

The AI/ML Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying intelligent solutions that solve meaningful business problems across Murphy USA. Unlike narrowly focused machine learning or generative AI roles, this position works across multiple AI disciplines and applies the most appropriate technology to each challenge.

Projects may include traditional machine learning, predictive analytics, recommendation systems, optimization, forecasting, agentic AI, generative AI, retrieval-augmented systems, and workflow automation. The focus is not on implementing technology for its own sake, but on delivering measurable business value through practical, scalable AI solutions.

This role will help develop and operationalize in-house AI products. The ideal candidate enjoys solving ambiguous problems, experimenting with new approaches, and taking ownership of outcomes. Team members are expected to continually expand their expertise, collaborate across disciplines, and contribute wherever needed to help deliver successful AI products.

This position may be filled at Level I, II, or III based on the candidate's demonstrated capabilities, experience, and ability to contribute within the role.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Design, develop, train, validate, and improve machine learning and AI models.

• Select appropriate AI, machine learning, statistical, optimization, or rules-based approaches based on business objectives and technical requirements.

• Develop predictive models, recommendation systems, optimization solutions, and agent-based applications.

• Create prompts, retrieval strategies, evaluation methods, and AI application workflows when appropriate.

• Develop AI-powered solutions using Python, Databricks, PySpark, SQL, and Azure.

• Collaborate with Data & Feature Engineers to define data, feature, and quality requirements.

• Build secure, maintainable integrations between AI solutions and approved enterprise systems, tools, and services.

• Prepare models and AI applications for production deployment, including testing, documentation, versioning, and handoff requirements.

• Design and execute experiments and evaluations to improve solution quality, reliability, safety, and performance.

• Monitor production results with AI/ML Operations Engineers and incorporate feedback into future iterations.

• Conduct exploratory analysis and prototyping to identify promising solution approaches.

• Partner with business stakeholders alongside the Manager of AI Implementation & Strategy to understand challenges and translate requirements into technical solutions.

• Communicate technical concepts, recommendations, limitations, and results to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Contribute reusable frameworks, libraries, development standards, and technical documentation.

• Follow enterprise governance, security, privacy, responsible AI, and data-management requirements.

• Continuously explore emerging technologies and cross-train across data engineering and AI operations when doing so improves team delivery.


Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, or a related quantitative field preferred, or equivalent practical experience.

• Experience with Python, SQL, Databricks, PySpark, Azure, and machine learning development.

• Understanding of machine learning, optimization, statistical techniques, software engineering principles, and modern AI architectures.

• Familiarity with generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic systems, or model evaluation is preferred.

• Ability to balance engineering rigor, experimentation, and practical business needs.

• Experience with source control, testing, documentation, and collaborative software development practices is preferred.

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking abilities.

• Ability to work independently, take initiative, and maintain accountability for outcomes.

• Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated commitment to continuous learning.

title: UX/Concept Designer
descriptionHtml:
Team: Build, Frontier Firm Live (FFL)

Reports to: Head of Build

Location: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (preference for Saudi-based candidates)

Type: Full‑time

Why This Role Matters

Sulava MEA is building the platform and product experience behind Frontier Firm Live, our AI agent offering for enterprise customers across the Middle East and Africa. As we scale, the experience people have with our agents, our platform, and our AI Teammates is becoming as important as the technology underneath it. We are looking for a UX/Concept Designer who can shape that experience end to end: the platform interface, the user journeys, and how our AI agents actually behave, sound, and respond when a real person is talking to them.

This is a hands-on design role inside a technical team. You will work daily alongside AI Engineers, the Integration Engineer, and the Platform Architect, not handing off a finished design and walking away, but staying involved through to what actually gets built.

What You Will Design

  • The user interface of the FFL platform, including layout, navigation, and interaction patterns, using a consistent design system
  • End-to-end user journeys across the platform, from onboarding through everyday use
  • Conversational and agent interaction patterns: how our AI agents communicate confidence, limitations, and handoff to a human
  • Multilingual experiences, including Arabic, for agents and interfaces used across the region
  • Prototypes and concepts that get tested and validated before engineering time is committed to building them

What You Will Do

  • Design the FFL platform's UI and user journeys, working from concept through to build-ready handoff
  • Design how our AI agents and AI Teammates communicate, including conversational flow, tone, and recovery when an agent gets something wrong
  • Work directly with AI Engineers and the Integration Engineer to make sure your designs are technically implementable, not just visually appealing
  • Maintain a design system and reusable component library for the FFL platform
  • Run lightweight user research and usability testing to validate design decisions
  • Design with Arabic and multilingual use in mind from the start, not as an afterthought translation pass

What You Bring

  • A strong portfolio of UX/UI and concept design work that you can walk us through in detail. This is a hard requirement, applications without a portfolio will not be considered
  • Demonstrable experience designing for software platforms, ideally SaaS, enterprise, or platform products
  • Experience working with Microsoft technologies (Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or Copilot Studio interfaces). This is a hard requirement, given the Microsoft-first stack we build on
  • Experience designing end-to-end user journeys, not just individual screens
  • Strong communication skills, with demonstrable ability to work directly with engineers and technical architects through to delivery
  • A working understanding of how frontend and backend systems interact, sufficient to design solutions that are realistic to build, not just visually appealing

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing for AI, agent, or conversational interfaces, particularly where you have shaped how an AI system communicates with users
  • Experience with dynamic, AI-generated, or personalised content design, where the interface adapts to model output rather than static content
  • Arabic language skills, written and spoken. This is a strong advantage given our multilingual customer base and the need to design conversational patterns and user journeys that work naturally in Arabic, not just translated from English
  • Based in Saudi Arabia, or willing to relocate
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards for enterprise software

How We Work

Sulava MEA is a Frontier Firm: fast, clear, and deeply collaborative. Our culture is built on trust, expertise, and action. We value people who think boldly, deliver impact, and raise the bar for modern AI engineering and the experiences we build on top of it.

You will have access to top Microsoft expertise, MVP-level mentorship, ongoing learning opportunities, and projects that matter. Benefits include health insurance, flexible working arrangements, a professional development budget, and relocation support where applicable.

Additional Application Requirements

Portfolio of Work

Please include a link to your portfolio. We want to see real, shipped work wherever possible, not only concept or student projects. Walk us through a small number of projects in depth rather than listing many briefly: what the problem was, what you designed, and what changed as a result.

Optional Video Introduction

Please include a link to a short video introducing yourself and your design approach. The video does not need to be professionally produced, a simple recording is perfectly fine.

Our Interview Process

  • First interview: a portfolio review with the Head of Build and a member of the Build technical team, to understand your design thinking and how you have worked with engineers before
  • Additional interview: may be required depending on what you showcase in your first interview
  • Final interview: with the Head of AI Build at Sulava
