title: Associate Research Scientist/ Post-Doctoral Associate in the Division of Science (Computer Science) - Dr. Djellel Difallah
location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
descriptionHtml:
The laboratory of Dr. Djellel Difallah in the Division of Science, New York University Abu Dhabi, seeks a Post-Doctoral Associate or a Associate Research Scientist to join a lab focused on applied machine learning.

The successful applicant will participate in research involving human computation, knowledge discovery, machine learning, and data science. The position will provide the opportunity to develop applied research skills in machine learning, interact with an international network of collaborators, and gain post-doctoral research experience.

Skills

The ideal candidate is self-motivated and can work independently, has a passion for AI and its applications, and is willing to learn new technologies. The candidate should have a PhD in Computer Science or a closely related field. Relevant background and skills include:

  • Strong foundation in one of the following areas: Machine Learning / Information Retrieval / Knowledge Graph Representation / Recommender Systems
  • Graph Theory/Network Science
  • Python, and up-to-date machine learning libraries
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Track record of publishing in top tier conferences

For consideration, applicants need to submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, list of publications (if applicable), a 1-page statement of research interests, and three letters of reference. If you have any questions, please email: djellel@nyu.edu

title: AI & Digital Experience Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Job Code: JPC - 6104

Job Title: AI & Digital Experience Analyst

Job Location: Abu Dhabi

Contract: 12 Months

Job Summary

The AI & Digital Experience Analyst serves as the execution and innovation engine for the Technology Operations division. Reporting directly to the Associate Director of Technology Operations, this role focuses on translating high-level AI architectures into functional prototypes, driving enterprise-wide AI adoption, including Microsoft Copilot, and measuring the operational impact of the Technology Operations division.

The role acts as the in-house Copilot Expert, responsible for enabling and coaching end users to build their own agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, including advanced, multi-step agents that connect to enterprise data and automate business workflows.

The Analyst bridges the gap between technical AI development and end-user experience, ensuring that Technology Services is positioned as a proactive, value-driving partner to the business.

Core Accountabilities

  • AI Prototyping & Execution: Act as the primary builder for internal AI agents and automation tools, transforming architectural designs and logic workflows provided by TechOps leadership into testable, functional models.
  • Copilot Studio Expertise: Serve as the subject-matter expert for Microsoft Copilot Studio, helping end users design, build, and publish their own agents, from simple question-and-answer bots to advanced agents with custom topics, actions, connectors, knowledge sources, and orchestration.
  • Enterprise AI Adoption: Lead user campaigns and training programs across the organization to drive adoption of digital workplace tools, specifically spearheading Microsoft Copilot training initiatives.
  • Strategic Impact Reporting: Design and maintain executive dashboards and Impact Stories that translate complex TechOps achievements, such as automated ticket deflection, infrastructure cost savings, and system uptime, into clear business-facing metrics.

Operational Responsibilities

  • Copilot Studio Enablement: Run hands-on workshops and one-to-one coaching sessions that guide end users through building agents in Microsoft Copilot Studio, including advanced capabilities such as custom topics, generative actions, knowledge sources, connectors, and agent orchestration.
  • Model Training & Testing: Ingest, format, and structure internal data, including policies and IT documentation, for AI knowledge bases. Conduct rigorous prompt testing, log hallucination rates, and refine agent outputs prior to production deployment.
  • Digital Experience Advocacy: Conduct live training sessions and workshops with business units to demonstrate the capabilities of deployed AI tools and gather user feedback for continuous improvement.
  • Proof of Concept (PoC) Development: Rapidly build internal PoCs using existing platforms to validate business requests before full implementation approval.
  • Governance & Best Practice: Define and share reusable templates, guardrails, and best-practice guidance so that user-built Copilot Studio agents remain secure, compliant, and aligned with organizational standards.
  • Performance Tracking: Monitor the daily usage and success rates of deployed AI Service Desk agents and provide weekly analytics on automated ticket resolution.

Job Qualifications & Experience

  • 5 10 years of overall experience.
  • Bachelor s degree in Artificial Intelligence, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field.
  • Strong foundational understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), prompt engineering, and AI toolsets.
  • Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Copilot Studio, including building and configuring agents, topics, actions, and connectors.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical business users.
  • Basic scripting capability, such as Python or PowerShell, for data formatting and API interactions.
  • High capacity for independent problem-solving and rapid prototyping.
  • Keep up to date with the latest AI tools and model releases and identify opportunities to leverage them internally.
  • High-agility, cloud-first infrastructure requiring rapid adaptation to new AI frameworks and continuous learning.

title: Junior Research Scientist in the Mubadala Arabian Center for Climate and Environmental Sciences (Marine Spatial Analysis) - Dr. John Burt
location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
descriptionHtml:
The Mubadala Arabian Center for Climate and Environmental Sciences (Mubadala ACCESS) at New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) invites applications for a Junior Research Scientist to support a multidisciplinary research program investigating the environmental and ecological drivers of productive fishing grounds in the United Arab Emirates.

Working alongside researchers from NYUAD and Emirates Nature–WWF, the successful candidate will contribute to marine habitat mapping, spatial analysis, and environmental data integration to support fisheries management and marine conservation.

The Junior Research Scientist will support the acquisition, processing, and analysis of marine spatial and environmental datasets collected throughout the project. Working within a multidisciplinary team, the successful candidate will assist in developing habitat maps, managing spatial databases, integrating environmental monitoring data, and producing analytical outputs that inform conservation planning and fisheries management.

The role combines office-based spatial analysis with opportunities to participate in field surveys, environmental monitoring, and marine habitat assessments across the UAE.

The successful candidate will assist with processing GIS, bathymetric, habitat, and environmental datasets, maintaining project databases, and supporting the development of habitat maps and spatial products. Responsibilities include assisting with side-scan sonar and underwater imagery processing, data quality assurance, statistical analyses, and preparation of maps, figures, reports, and scientific publications.

The Junior Research Scientist will also participate in field campaigns to collect environmental and spatial reference data and contribute to project reporting and stakeholder deliverables.

Applicants must hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marine Science, Geography, GIS, Oceanography, Environmental Science, Spatial Ecology, or a closely related discipline. Master’s degree and less than 5 years of research experience in the relevant field, or a Bachelor's degree with any level of experience.

The ideal candidate will have experience using GIS software such as ArcGIS or QGIS, managing scientific datasets, and conducting quantitative analyses using software such as R or Python. Experience with marine habitat mapping, environmental monitoring data, side-scan sonar, or remote sensing is desirable. Candidates should possess strong analytical and organizational skills and be comfortable working both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research team.

To be considered, all applicants must submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, transcript of degree/ copy of highest degree, and a research statement, all in PDF format. Contact information for 2 references will be requested from shortlisted candidates.

Applications will be accepted immediately and candidates will be considered until the position is filled. If you have any questions, please reach out to Kelly Bradham email: kelly.bradham@nyu.edu

About NYU Abu Dhabi

https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/

NYU Abu Dhabi is the first comprehensive liberal arts and research campus in the Middle East to be operated abroad by a major American research university. Times Higher Education ranks NYU among the top 30 universities in the world, making NYU Abu Dhabi the highest-ranked university in the UAE and MENA region. NYU Abu Dhabi has integrated a highly selective undergraduate curriculum across the disciplines with a world center for advanced research and scholarship. The university enables its students in the sciences, engineering, social sciences, humanities, and arts to succeed in an increasingly interdependent world and advance cooperation and progress on humanity’s shared challenges. NYU Abu Dhabi’s high-achieving students have come from over 120 countries and speak over 100 languages. Together, NYU's campuses in New York, Abu Dhabi, and Shanghai form the backbone of a unique global university, giving faculty and students opportunities to experience varied learning environments and immersion in other cultures at one or more of the numerous study-abroad sites NYU maintains on six continents.

NYUAD is committed to upholding a culture of non-discrimination, anti-harassment, dignity, and mutual respect; providing equal access and opportunity; and fostering academic excellence in learning, research, and teaching.

Students are drawn from among the world’s best. They are bright, intellectually passionate, and committed to building a campus environment anchored in mutual respect, understanding, and care. The NYUAD undergraduate student body has garnered an impressive record of scholarships, graduate-school admissions, and other global honors. Graduate education is an area of growth for the University; the current graduate student population of over 100 students is expected to expand in the next decade as doctoral programs are developed.

At NYUAD, we recognize that Abu Dhabi is more than where you work; it’s your home. In order for research staff to thrive, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. This starts with a generous relocation allowance; educational assistance for your dependents; access to health and wellness services; and more. NYUAD is committed to research staff success throughout the academic trajectory, providing support for ambitious and world-class research projects and innovative, interactive teaching approaches. Support for dual-career families is a priority.

Visit our website for more information on benefits for you and your dependents.

NYUAD is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and seek individuals who will contribute to the excellence and vibrancy of our academic community.

Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates. In line with UAE regulations, Emirati candidates are encouraged to apply.

Join NYU Abu Dhabi, an exceptional place for exceptional people.

NYUAD values belonging and respect; such principles are fundamental to the university’s commitment to excellence. NYUAD is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and seek individuals who will contribute to our vibrant, multidisciplinary research and teaching community. Multidisciplinary research and exceptional teaching in a global campus community are hallmarks of the University’s mission.

descriptionText:
The Mubadala Arabian Center for Climate and Environmental Sciences (Mubadala ACCESS) at New York University Abu Dhabi (NYUAD) invites applications for a Junior Research Scientist to support a multidisciplinary research program investigating the environmental and ecological drivers of productive fishing grounds in the United Arab Emirates.

Working alongside researchers from NYUAD and Emirates Nature–WWF, the successful candidate will contribute to marine habitat mapping, spatial analysis, and environmental data integration to support fisheries management and marine conservation.

The Junior Research Scientist will support the acquisition, processing, and analysis of marine spatial and environmental datasets collected throughout the project. Working within a multidisciplinary team, the successful candidate will assist in developing habitat maps, managing spatial databases, integrating environmental monitoring data, and producing analytical outputs that inform conservation planning and fisheries management.

The role combines office-based spatial analysis with opportunities to participate in field surveys, environmental monitoring, and marine habitat assessments across the UAE.

The successful candidate will assist with processing GIS, bathymetric, habitat, and environmental datasets, maintaining project databases, and supporting the development of habitat maps and spatial products. Responsibilities include assisting with side-scan sonar and underwater imagery processing, data quality assurance, statistical analyses, and preparation of maps, figures, reports, and scientific publications.

The Junior Research Scientist will also participate in field campaigns to collect environmental and spatial reference data and contribute to project reporting and stakeholder deliverables.

Applicants must hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marine Science, Geography, GIS, Oceanography, Environmental Science, Spatial Ecology, or a closely related discipline. Master’s degree and less than 5 years of research experience in the relevant field, or a Bachelor's degree with any level of experience.

The ideal candidate will have experience using GIS software such as ArcGIS or QGIS, managing scientific datasets, and conducting quantitative analyses using software such as R or Python. Experience with marine habitat mapping, environmental monitoring data, side-scan sonar, or remote sensing is desirable. Candidates should possess strong analytical and organizational skills and be comfortable working both independently and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary research team.

To be considered, all applicants must submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, transcript of degree/ copy of highest degree, and a research statement, all in PDF format. Contact information for 2 references will be requested from shortlisted candidates.

Applications will be accepted immediately and candidates will be considered until the position is filled. If you have any questions, please reach out to Kelly Bradham email: kelly.bradham@nyu.edu

title: Data Science Consultant
descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

The Data Science Consultant sits within Stellar’s Solutions practice. The team’s mandate is simple: turn data into decisions. We deliver customized, high-value insights through data analysis and modeling, acting as the bridge between what a client’s business needs and what the technology can actually do — and we hold ourselves to a high bar on the quality of what goes out the door.

Responsibilities And Duties

  • Lead the delivery of a broad range of projects and services across Value Creation Insights and other engagements that carry significant business and/or technical complexity.
  • Act as the translator between business and technical requirements — shaping project scope, defining customization needs, and packaging outcomes so they land clearly with business executives.
  • Support the Executive Team and Sales in building proposals that require a tailored approach, and align resourcing with the delivery team accordingly.
  • Build custom analytical approaches for insights that fall outside Stellar’s standard data pipelines — this means hands-on coding in Python/SQL, and continuously checking and improving model, classification, and clustering performance while correcting for content bias.
  • Own quality control across both standard data pipelines (from data lineage and sourcing through to insight generation) and custom-built approaches — reviewing outputs from both a business and a technical lens, and iterating until the outcome is right.
  • Translate findings into clear, executive-ready PowerPoint presentations and Power BI dashboards.
  • Represent Stellar in client read-outs, presenting results directly to client stakeholders.
  • Manage handovers to clients and stay accountable for their ongoing success with the solution delivered.
  • Support the Value Creation Insights Product Lead on broader solution development work alongside day-to-day client delivery.
  • Follow Stellar’s information security policies, procedures, and standards within the scope of the role, and support our ISO certification and ISMS commitments.
  • Proactively identify and push for improvements, building the case for their inclusion in the product/solutions roadmap.

Education, Required Skills And Experience

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Econometrics, or Engineering, with at least one year of business curriculum and one year of data/analytics/statistics curriculum.
  • 3+ years of professional experience, ideally in strategy consulting, spanning a broad range of projects — with at least one year specifically in Growth, Strategy, and Marketing.
  • Strong command of quantitative methods for data analysis.
  • Demonstrated track record building robust analytics solutions, not just prototypes.
  • Ability to quickly get to grips with complex business topics, structure problems clearly, form and test hypotheses, and carry a solution through to execution.
  • Strong communication skills — structured, empathetic, and emotionally intelligent, especially in client-facing settings.
  • Working knowledge of:
    • Supervised and unsupervised learning model evaluation
    • Data transformation
    • Data visualization (charts and dashboards)
    • Core Python data science packages (pandas, numpy, scipy, scikit-learn, etc.)
    • NLP packages such as spaCy
    • Transformer/LLM-based NLP pipelines
  • Working knowledge of software engineering fundamentals: Python, SQL and databases, Git, API/web service development (e.g., FastAPI).
  • Working familiarity with MLOps, SSH, Linux terminal, Bash, UI development (app or web-based), system architecture, and agile methodologies.
  • Fluency in English, written and spoken.
  • A respectful team player with high ethical standards.
Preferred Skills And Experience (Upside)

  • Due diligence experience in a deal/transaction context.
  • Multilingual.
  • A track record of high achievement — sports, arts, games, academics, competitions, awards — any domain.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Azure DevOps Services.
  • Experience with deep learning libraries such as TensorFlow or PyTorch.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-based NLP/LLM platforms — OpenAI’s GPT/ChatGPT, Meta’s Llama, IBM Watson NLP, Amazon Comprehend, Azure NLP, Google NLP, BERT, Gemini, or similar.
  • Knowledge of containers and orchestration (Docker, Docker Compose, Kubernetes).

Job Category: Data science consultant

Job Type: Full Time

Job Location: UAE

title: Associate AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Location:  Hybrid, United States

Employment Type: Full-Time

Benefits Offered: Vision, Medical, Life, Dental, 401K

Gross Annual Base Salary: USD 87,000 - 116,000

Additional variable compensation and benefits may apply. Total compensation is based on experience, skills, and location using objective, job-related criteria.

This role requires the candidate to work from one of the following OneStream office locations: Birmingham, MI, Fort Lauderdale, FL, New York, NY, or Chicago, IL.

Summary

As an Associate AI Engineer you will be a critical member in executing our AI initiatives within the OneStream platform. The AI Product and Engineering team is focused on bridging the gap between AI research and AI products, bringing tangible and quantifiable value to our end users. Our AI solutions incorporate applications across the AI and machine learning spectrum, including (but not limited to) time series forecasting, anomaly detection, and natural language processing. Our mission is to lower the barrier for organizations and people to get value out of AI capabilities.

Primary Duties And Responsibilities

  • Develop scalable, high-performance applications and services using a variety of software architecture design patterns.
  • Implement robust software systems and functionalities using Python and SQL/NoSQL, ensuring optimal performance and scalability.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues across the full stack, from the user interface to the database layer.
  • Participate in technical design sessions to decompose and design complex systems and interfaces.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure technical and user requirements are met.
  • Must be a self-starter, continuously be learning both best code practices and the latest technologies in the Software ecosystem.
  • Must understand data analysis and how to apply data science solutions into end products.

Required Education And Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree or similar work experience.
  • CS/EE/CE Degree or similar experience.
  • 1-2 years of experience building and deploying production-level machine learning solutions or similar experience.
  • 1-2 years of strong programming experience with one of the following: Python, C++, C, CSharp, Java, Rust, or Go (or similar experience).

Preferred Education And Experience

  • Experience building and deploying production-level software solutions or similar experience.
  • Experience with webservices and API frameworks (Flask, FastAPI, etc.).
  • Experience with relational or non-relational databases (MS SQL Server).
  • Knowledge of distributed systems and cloud-based computing (Azure).
  • Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch, Sklearn).

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Self-Starter to decompose a problem and plan a solution.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies and adapt to changes in technology and the business environment.
  • Highly adaptive to changing circumstances, with the ability to tackle problems quickly.
  • Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent organization, scheduling, project management and multi-tasking skills.
  • Ability to write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.
  • Interest in continuous learning opportunities as the software landscape continues to evolve.
  • Capable and comfortable effectively presenting in front of your peers.
  • Proficient in effectively prioritizing and executing tasks in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.
  • Highly self-motivated and proactive.
  • Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail.
  • Comfortable engaging and presenting to C-level executives from time to time.
  • Employee must be legally authorized to work in the country of the job position as a precondition of employment.

Travel

Minimal travel required.

Who We Are

OneStream is how today’s Finance teams can go beyond just reporting on the past and Take Finance Further™ by steering the business to the future. It’s the only enterprise finance platform that unifies financial and operational data, embeds AI for better decisions and productivity, and empowers the CFO to become a critical driver of business strategy and execution.    Our vision is to be the AI operating system for modern finance, digitizing core financial functions and empowering the CFO to become a critical driver of business strategy. To learn more visit www.onestream.com.

Why Join the OneStream Team

  • Transparency around corporate structure, salary, and benefits
  • Core value of customer success
  • Variety of project work (not industry specific)
  • Strong culture and camaraderie
  • Multiple training opportunities

Benefits At OneStream

OneStream employees are passionate, hardworking individuals who go above and beyond to keep our customers happy and follow through on our mission statement. They consistently deliver the best and in turn, we make every effort to keep them cared for and happy. A sample of the benefits we provide are:

  • Excellent Medical Plan
  • Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Short & Long Term Disability
  • Vacation Time
  • Paid Holidays
  • Professional Development
  • Retirement Plan

All candidates must be legally authorized to work for any company in the country where this position is located without sponsorship.

OneStream is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Business Analyst
location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
descriptionHtml:
Business Analyst

Abu Dhabi, UAE | Office-based


AppliedAI, founded in 2021, is a pioneering AI technology company headquartered in Abu Dhabi, UAE. We are committed to innovation and excellence in artificial intelligence solutions across regulated industries such as healthcare, insurance, government, and financial services.


Our flagship platform, Opus, automates and supervises mission-critical, document-heavy processes with embedded governance, auditability, and human oversight. We help enterprises achieve measurable productivity gains while increasing operational reliability and trust.


With over 400 employees across 9 locations, AppliedAI is pursuing strategic expansion of its UAE-based Delivery Team due to strong client demand.



About the Role:


We're looking for a talented Business Analyst to join our growing post-sales AI Solutions Delivery team, supporting client success on Opus, our agentic AI workflow automation platform for regulated industries.


In this role, you'll work alongside our AI Solutions Consultants and Project Managers as part of an agile delivery squad, facilitating enterprise clients to map out how their processes actually run today so our team can turn that into a working, automated solution powered with agentic AI.


You'll be process-minded and detail-oriented, comfortable running structured conversations with client teams, and confident capturing and documenting complex operational workflows clearly enough that others can build from them. You’re familiar with BPMN process mapping, or similar methodologies.



Key Responsibilities


Discovery & Process Mapping


  • Support discovery sessions with client teams to map current-state business processes: who does each step, how long it takes, what rules apply, where things commonly go wrong, the pain points, the technology systems involved and the integrations landscape
  • Help build shared process maps and visual workflow diagrams that client stakeholders can review, correct, and sign off on before build begins, on the Opus Discovery Tool
  • Ask clarifying questions to surface the real, as-practiced process, not just the officially documented version.

title: Post-Doctoral Associate in the Center for Interdisciplinary Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (CIDSAI) - Dr. Pierre Youssef
location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
descriptionHtml:
The Center of Interdisciplinary Data Science and Artificial Intelligence (CIDSAI) at NYU Abu Dhabi seeks to recruit a highly motivated Post-Doctoral Associate to work on topics in the theoretical foundations of data science and AI.

Responsibilities

  • Conduct research on automated reasoning and proof checker, AI-assisted collaboration.
  • Develop and analyze algorithms for learning and optimization.
  • Participate in collaborative research projects and mentoring.
  • Contribute to academic publications, reports and seminars

The Selected Candidate Will Be Part Of The Foundations Cluster Of CIDSAI And Will Collaborate Closely With Professor Saurabh Ray, And Professor Pierre Youssef. We Are Particularly Interested In Candidates With a Strong Mathematical Background And Expertise In One Or More Of The Following Areas

  • High-dimensional probability and concentration/functional inequalities
  • Markov processes and stochastic analysis
  • Theoretical analysis of neural networks and deep learning
  • Foundations of reinforcement learning and bandit algorithms
  • Mathematical and algorithmic perspectives on large language models
  • Statistical learning theory and complexity analysis
  • Automated theorem proving and formal methods
  • Random matrix theory and its applications in modern AI systems

Requirements: PhD in Mathematics, Computer Science or related fields, with no more than five years post-receipt of PhD.

The appointment is for two years, with the possibility of renewal.

The terms of employment are very competitive and include housing and educational subsidies for children. Applications will be accepted immediately and candidates will be considered until the position is filled.

To be considered, all applicants must submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, transcript of degree, a maximum three pages summary of research accomplishments and interests, and at least 2 letters of recommendation, all in PDF format.

Further questions may be directed to Professor Pierre Youssef at yp27@nyu.edu.

About NYU Abu Dhabi

https://nyuad.nyu.edu/en/

NYU Abu Dhabi is the first comprehensive liberal arts and research campus in the Middle East to be operated abroad by a major American research university. Times Higher Education ranks NYU among the top 30 universities in the world, making NYU Abu Dhabi the highest-ranked university in the UAE and MENA region. NYU Abu Dhabi has integrated a highly selective undergraduate curriculum across the disciplines with a world center for advanced research and scholarship. The university enables its students in the sciences, engineering, social sciences, humanities, and arts to succeed in an increasingly interdependent world and advance cooperation and progress on humanity’s shared challenges. NYU Abu Dhabi’s high-achieving students have come from over 120 countries and speak over 100 languages. Together, NYU's campuses in New York, Abu Dhabi, and Shanghai form the backbone of a unique global university, giving faculty and students opportunities to experience varied learning environments and immersion in other cultures at one or more of the numerous study-abroad sites NYU maintains on six continents.

NYUAD is committed to upholding a culture of non-discrimination, anti-harassment, dignity, and mutual respect; providing equal access and opportunity; and fostering academic excellence in learning, research, and teaching.

Students are drawn from among the world’s best. They are bright, intellectually passionate, and committed to building a campus environment anchored in mutual respect, understanding, and care. The NYUAD undergraduate student body has garnered an impressive record of scholarships, graduate-school admissions, and other global honors. Graduate education is an area of growth for the University; the current graduate student population of over 100 students is expected to expand in the next decade as doctoral programs are developed.

Working for NYUAD

At NYUAD, we recognize that Abu Dhabi is more than where you work; it’s your home. In order for research staff to thrive, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. This starts with a generous relocation allowance; educational assistance for your dependents; access to health and wellness services; and more. NYUAD is committed to research staff success throughout the academic trajectory, providing support for ambitious and world-class research projects and innovative, interactive teaching approaches. Support for dual-career families is a priority.

Visit our website for more information on benefits for you and your dependents.

NYUAD is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and seek individuals who will contribute to the excellence and vibrancy of our academic community.

Applications are welcome from all qualified candidates. In line with UAE regulations, Emirati candidates are encouraged to apply.

Join NYU Abu Dhabi, an exceptional place for exceptional people.

NYUAD values belonging and respect; such principles are fundamental to the university’s commitment to excellence. NYUAD is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and seek individuals who will contribute to our vibrant, multidisciplinary research and teaching community. Multidisciplinary research and exceptional teaching in a global campus community are hallmarks of the University’s mission.

@WorkAtNYUAD

For people in the EU, click here for information on your privacy rights under GDPR: www.nyu.edu/it/gdpr

NYU is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to a policy of equal treatment and opportunity in every aspect of its recruitment and hiring process without regard to age, alienage, caregiver status, childbirth, citizenship status, color, creed, disability, domestic violence victim status, ethnicity, familial status, gender and/or gender identity or expression, marital status, military status, national origin, parental status, partnership status, predisposing genetic characteristics, pregnancy, race, religion, reproductive health decision making, sex, sexual orientation, unemployment status, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis. All interested persons are encouraged to apply for vacant positions at all levels.

Sustainability Statement

NYU aims to be among the greenest urban campuses in the country and carbon neutral by 2040. Learn more at nyu.edu/sustainability

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
descriptionHtml:
Copilot Studio Developer - 12 Month Contract - Abu Dhabi


📍 Abu Dhabi – Onsite

💰 AED 25,000 per month + Visa + Healthcare

📅 12-Month Contract – Potential to become Permanent after initial contract

🚀 Immediate Joiner Required


We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Copilot Studio Developer / AI Conversational Engineer to join a major organization in Abu Dhabi.


This is a hands-on technical role focused on designing, developing and deploying AI-powered conversational agents and copilots using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365, Power Platform and Azure AI.


You will work closely with business and technology teams to transform business use cases into secure, scalable and measurable conversational AI solutions that improve productivity, automate workflows and allow users to interact with enterprise systems and knowledge through natural language.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop conversational AI agents and copilots using Microsoft Copilot Studio
  • Build topics, actions, dialog flows and agent orchestration patterns
  • Translate business requirements into conversational designs, prompts, user journeys and integrations
  • Integrate copilots with enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Dataverse, Power Platform and Microsoft Teams
  • Build integrations using REST APIs, connectors, Power Automate, Azure Functions and custom actions
  • Implement RAG, prompt engineering, grounding strategies and human-in-the-loop patterns
  • Work with Azure AI, Azure OpenAI and Azure AI Foundry
  • Configure copilots across Teams, Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint and web channels
  • Apply enterprise security, privacy, responsible AI, access control and governance standards
  • Develop proofs of concept and industrialise successful solutions into production environments
  • Monitor agent accuracy, adoption, usage and performance and continuously improve AI responses
  • Produce technical documentation, reusable templates and handover materials


Required Experience

  • 4+ years' experience across software development, AI development, automation, low-code/no-code or chatbot development
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio
  • Strong experience with Power Platform and Power Automate
  • Good understanding of conversational AI, generative AI and prompt engineering
  • Experience with RAG / knowledge grounding
  • Experience integrating enterprise applications using REST APIs, JSON, connectors and authentication patterns
  • Working knowledge of technologies including:
  • Azure AI / Azure OpenAI
  • Azure AI Foundry
  • Microsoft Graph
  • Dataverse
  • SharePoint
  • Microsoft Teams
  • Microsoft Entra ID
  • Experience designing secure and governed AI solutions within enterprise environments
  • Strong stakeholder communication skills


Desirable Experience

  • Microsoft certifications such as AI-102, PL-400, PL-600, Azure Developer or Azure AI Engineer
  • Microsoft 365 Copilot extensibility
  • Agent governance and AI observability
  • Enterprise RAG architectures and knowledge management
  • Experience developing agents for employee productivity, operational support, customer service or workflow automation
  • Aviation and/or ground services industry experience would be advantageous
  • Development experience with Python, C#, JavaScript or TypeScript
